Chapter 8. AI-Driven Applications
AI 驱动应用

In previous chapters, we demonstrated how to deploy model servers like vLLM on Kubernetes, package model data, and operate inference at scale. Building on that foundation, we will now shift from serving single models to architecting complete AI-driven applications where an LLM is just one of many components.

前面几章我们演示了如何在 Kubernetes 上部署 vLLM 等模型服务器、打包模型数据、大规模运营推理。在此基础上，我们现在从服务单个模型转向架构完整的 AI 驱动应用——其中 LLM 只是众多组件之一。

This chapter focuses on application architecture: how requests flow through a system, how context is retrieved or tools are invoked, and how state is maintained over time. We will introduce popular architectural patterns, the key components of AI application stacks, and the challenges of integrating LLMs into real-world applications. To maintain a clear focus on the architectural overview, we will keep the discussion at a high level. We will dive deeper into more concrete technical developments in the next chapter.

本章聚焦应用架构：请求如何流经系统、上下文如何被检索、工具如何被调用、状态如何随时间维护。我们会介绍流行的架构模式、AI 应用栈的关键组件，以及把 LLM 集成到真实应用中的挑战。为保持对架构概览的清晰聚焦，讨论保持在高层；下一章再深入更具体的技术细节。

LLMs started their march of conquest into mainstream software as chatbots, with ChatGPT as their most prominent representative. Chat is still the dominant interaction pattern, but the software behind it has grown up. Modern AI apps wrap an LLM with application logic that fetches business context, calls internal systems, and writes state. The LLM inference service is a powerful component, but it does not reach into databases or call tools by itself.

LLM 以聊天机器人为先锋进军主流软件，ChatGPT 是最突出代表。对话仍是主导交互模式，但背后的软件已经成熟。现代 AI 应用用应用逻辑包裹 LLM——拉取业务上下文、调用内部系统、写入状态。LLM 推理服务是强大组件，但它自己不会钻进数据库或调用工具。

The application is in charge and uses the LLM for generation or reasoning. You will see where to use retrieval for grounding, when to orchestrate tool calls, and how to keep state across turns without losing control of cost, latency, and quality.

应用掌握主动权，用 LLM 做生成或推理。你会看到何时用检索做锚定、何时编排工具调用，以及如何在多轮间保持状态而不失去对成本、延迟与质量的控制。

In the next section, "Architectural Patterns" on page 262, we will see two fundamental setups for embedding such AI-driven applications in a wider operational landscape.

下一节（第 262 页“架构模式”）我们会看到把这类 AI 驱动应用嵌入更广泛运营环境的两种基本设置。

Following that architectural overview, we'll shed some light on important concepts for creating AI-driven applications, namely retrieval-augmented generation in "Retrieval-Augmented Generation" on page 274 and agentic workflows in "Agentic Workflows" on page 286.

在架构概览之后，我们会阐明创建 AI 驱动应用的重要概念——即第 274 页“检索增强生成”中的 RAG，以及第 286 页“智能体工作流”中的 agentic workflow。

By the end of this chapter, you'll have a good understanding of the categories of AI-driven application and how generative AI workloads integrate into broader systems.

读完本章，你会对 AI 驱动应用的类别以及生成式 AI 负载如何集成到更广泛系统中有良好理解。

Let's jump now into the general architecture and deployment topologies for AI-driven applications on Kubernetes.

现在我们切入 Kubernetes 上 AI 驱动应用的通用架构与部署拓扑。

Architectural Patterns
架构模式

Before we dive into the typical architectures of AI apps, let's recap the most important Kubernetes workload types so we can map them to the architectural components we describe.

在深入 AI 应用的典型架构之前，先回顾最重要的 Kubernetes 负载类型，以便把它们映射到我们描述的架构组件。

Mapping each responsibility to the right Kubernetes primitive allows decoupled lifecycles and release cadences. For example, the LLM serving instances might be updated on a different schedule than the application logic deployment. This separation lets you upgrade or scale one part without disrupting others and aligns well with microservice best practices now applied to LLM-centric apps.

把每项职责映射到合适的 Kubernetes 原语，可以解耦生命周期与发布节奏。例如 LLM 服务实例的更新节奏可能与应用逻辑 deployment 不同。这种分离让你升级或扩缩一部分时不影响其他部分，与现在应用到以 LLM 为中心的应用上的微服务最佳实践一致。

Note: LLM service can live outside Kubernetes

While we focus on deploying all components within Kubernetes, the LLM service can also run in another cluster or as a managed cloud service, like OpenAI, Anthropic, or Google's Vertex AI. This decoupling is common in production, given GPU constraints, and offers significant flexibility: your orchestrator and application logic remain in Kubernetes while inference scales independently as a service. AI gateways, as described in Chapter 4, provide a unified interface to both self-hosted and cloud-based models, allowing you to switch between them without changing application code.

虽然我们聚焦在 Kubernetes 内部署所有组件，LLM 服务也可以运行在另一个集群中，或作为托管云服务（如 OpenAI、Anthropic、Google Vertex AI）。受 GPU 约束，这种解耦在生产中很常见，并提供显著灵活性：你的编排器与应用逻辑留在 Kubernetes，推理作为服务独立扩缩。第 4 章描述的 AI 网关为自托管与云模型提供统一接口，让你在两者间切换而不改应用代码。

Kubernetes Workload Types
Kubernetes 负载类型

Let's take a closer look at the key Kubernetes primitives and their AI app roles. Each type is described in more detail in Kubernetes Patterns. We reference the corresponding patterns in italics:

我们仔细看看关键 Kubernetes 原语及其在 AI 应用中的角色。每种类型在 Kubernetes Patterns 中有更详细描述，我们用斜体引用对应模式：

  • Deployment — used for stateless services that are always running, for example, the main application backend or an event-driven orchestrator. Deployments manage rolling updates, scaling, and restart for these long-running components. In an AI app, the AI Orchestrator handles requests or events, while the LLM inference server, often with Graphics Processing Unit (GPU) requests, handles inference. Both run as deployments, which allows them to scale independently of each other. See the Declarative Deployment pattern.Deployment——用于始终运行的无状态服务，例如主应用后端或事件驱动编排器。Deployment 为这些长时间运行的组件管理滚动更新、扩缩与重启。在 AI 应用中，AI 编排器处理请求或事件，LLM 推理服务器（常带 GPU 请求）处理推理。两者都作为 deployment 运行，从而能独立扩缩。见声明式 Deployment 模式。
  • StatefulSet — used for stateful services that need stable identities or persistent storage. Examples include databases, caches, or vector stores that keep embeddings and context. StatefulSets ensure that these components survive restarts with their data intact. See the Stateful Service pattern.StatefulSet——用于需要稳定身份或持久存储的有状态服务。例子包括数据库、缓存、保存嵌入与上下文的向量存储。StatefulSet 确保这些组件重启后数据完好。见有状态服务模式。
  • Job/CronJob — used for one-off or scheduled tasks such as offline ingestion, report generation, or periodic maintenance. CronJobs trigger jobs on a schedule, while jobs run to completion and free resources afterward. See the Batch Job and Periodic Job patterns.Job/CronJob——用于一次性或定时任务，如离线摄取、报告生成、定期维护。CronJob 按计划触发 job，job 运行到完成后释放资源。见批作业与定时作业模式。
  • Ingress/Gateway — provides entry into the cluster for client requests. A standard Kubernetes Ingress Gateway routes external requests to the appropriate service. For AI-aware routing and scheduling strategies, refer to "LLM-Aware Routing" on page 139. The underlying techniques are described in the Service Discovery pattern.Ingress/Gateway——为客户端请求提供进入集群的入口。标准 Kubernetes Ingress Gateway 把外部请求路由到合适服务。AI 感知路由与调度策略见第 139 页“LLM 感知路由”。底层技术见服务发现模式。

By assigning the right Kubernetes primitive to each function, you set lifecycle boundaries in the system. Stateless logic in deployments can be updated and scaled independently, stateful data stores in StatefulSets maintain continuity, and ephemeral or scheduled work happens in jobs that incur cost only when needed. These boundaries also hint at different Service-Level Agreements (SLAs) and cost profiles; for example, a conversational API may need low latency and high availability, while a nightly summarization job can run with relaxed timing.

把合适的 Kubernetes 原语分配给每项功能，就在系统中设定了生命周期边界。Deployment 中的无状态逻辑可独立更新与扩缩；StatefulSet 中有状态数据存储保持连续性；临时或定时工作在 job 中进行，只在需要时产生成本。这些边界也暗示不同的服务级别协议（SLA）与成本特征；例如对话 API 可能需要低延迟与高可用，而夜间摘要作业可以宽松计时运行。

Keeping these workload types in mind will help you map the architectural components we describe onto a Kubernetes setup.

记住这些负载类型，有助于把我们描述的架构组件映射到 Kubernetes 部署。

Let's start with the most popular category of AI applications: UI-facing chat applications like ChatGPT.

我们从最流行的 AI 应用类别开始：面向 UI 的对话应用，如 ChatGPT。

Chat Applications
对话应用

The first example in Figure 8-1 is a chat-facing application. A user talks to a web or mobile UI, which calls a conversational backend. That backend orchestrates the flow: it retrieves relevant context from stores, calls domain tools or APIs when needed, builds a prompt, and then calls the LLM service for generation. After receiving the model output, the backend post-processes the result, updates per-user memory or other state, and returns the response to the client. This split keeps the LLM focused on generation while the app owns data access, side effects, and policy enforcement.

图 8-1 的第一个例子是面向对话的应用。用户与 Web 或移动 UI 对话，UI 调用对话后端。该后端编排流程：从存储中检索相关上下文，必要时调用领域工具或 API，构建 prompt，然后调用 LLM 服务做生成。收到模型输出后，后端后处理结果、更新每用户记忆或其他状态，并把响应返回客户端。这种切分让 LLM 专注生成，而应用掌控数据访问、副作用与策略执行。

原书第 301 页
原书第 302 页

This request-response–driven system exemplified by a chat application exhibits a linear flow of interactions. A user issues a request and waits for a response. The flow is synchronous from the user's perspective, even if multiple steps occur behind the scenes.

对话应用所代表的这种请求-响应驱动系统呈现线性交互流。用户发出请求并等待响应。从用户角度流程是同步的，即使后台发生多个步骤。

In such a chat-oriented AI app, the LLM is one component in the request flow, while the backend service is responsible for the overall conversation logic.

在这种面向对话的 AI 应用中，LLM 是请求流中的一个组件，而后端服务负责整体对话逻辑。

A typical sequence for a single user query is as follows. For the various components we add the proper Kubernetes workload type (like in Deployment):

单个用户查询的典型序列如下。对各组件我们加上合适的 Kubernetes 负载类型（如 Deployment）：

  1. Gateway or Ingress routes the user's request to the backend service (Ingress, Gateway).Gateway 或 Ingress 把用户请求路由到后端服务（Ingress、Gateway）。
  2. The AI Orchestrator receives the request and controls the chat logic. It may retrieve relevant context (for RAG), assemble the prompt, and call the LLM service for a completion. For agentic workflows, the orchestrator may invoke tools based on the LLM's output, requiring multiple LLM calls in a loop. This component implements the "brain" of the chat application—e.g., using frameworks like LangChain within its code to manage the prompt, memory, and tool usage. In "Retrieval-Augmented Generation" on page 274 and "Agentic Workflows" on page 286, we will focus on exactly this orchestrator component and how it is designed to deliver its value (Deployment).AI 编排器接收请求并控制对话逻辑。它可能检索相关上下文（用于 RAG）、组装 prompt、调用 LLM 服务做补全。对智能体工作流，编排器可能根据 LLM 输出调用工具，需要在循环中多次调用 LLM。这个组件实现对话应用的“大脑”——例如在代码中用 LangChain 等框架管理 prompt、记忆与工具使用。第 274 页“检索增强生成”与第 286 页“智能体工作流”将聚焦这个编排器组件及其价值交付设计（Deployment）。
  3. The LLM service performs inference and returns the model output. The orchestrator calls this internal service (or potentially an external API like OpenAI) with the prepared prompt and awaits the result. By isolating the LLM in its own service, we can scale or update the model independently of the application logic. Kubernetes admins might deploy this with GPU nodes and use autoscaling to handle variable load. Chapter 1 covered how to deploy and scale model servers; here we see them integrated into an app (Deployment).LLM 服务执行推理并返回模型输出。编排器用准备好的 prompt 调用这个内部服务（或外部 API 如 OpenAI）并等待结果。通过把 LLM 隔离在自己的服务中，我们可以独立于应用逻辑扩缩或更新模型。Kubernetes 管理员可能用 GPU 节点部署它并使用自动扩缩应对变化负载。第 1 章介绍了如何部署与扩缩模型服务器；这里我们看到它们集成到应用中（Deployment）。
  4. State management provides conversation memory or retrieval indexes in a database, cache, or vector store. This state can be stored in a database or cache, such as a Redis or Postgres instance for chat history, or a vector store for embeddings. On Kubernetes, these stateful components are typically run as StatefulSets with PersistentVolumes. The orchestrator service reads previous messages or stored vectors to include in the context ("retrieval"), and after the LLM responds, it might save the latest user query and LLM answer to this store. In our Kubernetes mapping, this database or vector index is a long-lived component that you scale or back up as needed, with replication if required for high availability (StatefulSet).状态管理在数据库、缓存或向量存储中提供对话记忆或检索索引。这个状态可存在数据库或缓存中，如用于对话历史的 Redis 或 Postgres 实例，或用于嵌入的向量存储。在 Kubernetes 上，这些有状态组件通常作为带 PersistentVolume 的 StatefulSet 运行。编排器服务读取先前消息或存储向量以包含在上下文中（“检索”），LLM 响应后可能把最新用户查询与 LLM 答案保存到该存储。在我们的 Kubernetes 映射中，这个数据库或向量索引是长生命周期组件，按需扩缩或备份，需要高可用时做复制（StatefulSet）。
  5. Response to client may include post-processing or final tool calls before sending the reply.响应客户端前可能包含后处理或最终工具调用。
原书第 303 页

This pattern keeps the LLM focused on generation or reasoning, while the application retains control over data access, tool use, and side effects. The entire chain runs in a single synchronous request cycle, meaning low latency is a priority. To meet Service-Level Objective (SLO) demands (say, subsecond or a few seconds per response), the Kubernetes setup would keep the orchestrator and LLM pods running and ready. Techniques like autoscaling might be employed to handle bursts, but you wouldn't spin these up from zero for each request due to startup time.

这种模式让 LLM 专注生成或推理，而应用保留对数据访问、工具使用与副作用的控制。整条链在单个同步请求周期中运行，意味着低延迟是优先项。为满足 SLO 需求（如亚秒或每响应几秒），Kubernetes 部署会保持编排器与 LLM Pod 运行并就绪。可用自动扩缩等技术处理突发，但由于启动时间，不会为每个请求从零拉起。

A benefit of having a user-facing application architecture is that it is easy to participate in distributed authentication workflows like OAuth2 that involve browser redirects to authentication servers. This makes security setups simpler and more straightforward than when dealing with backend services, as described in "Backend AI Services" on page 266.

面向用户的应用架构的一个好处是容易参与 OAuth2 等分布式认证工作流——涉及浏览器重定向到认证服务器。这使安全设置比处理后端服务更简单直接，如第 266 页“后端 AI 服务”所述。

This architecture separates concerns so that the conversational logic (often updated frequently as prompts and tool integrations evolve) is decoupled from the LLM model serving (which might change only when a new model or version is available). The database can be treated as an external dependency that rarely changes. This decoupling means that each piece can be upgraded independently—for instance, deploying a new version of the orchestrator deployment with improved prompt handling, without touching the LLM deployment or wiping any stored data. It also allows scaling each component based on its usage; e.g., many chat sessions mainly load the LLM and database, so scale those up, whereas the orchestrator code might be lightweight compute-bound and need fewer replicas.

这种架构分离关注点，使对话逻辑（随 prompt 与工具集成演进而频繁更新）与 LLM 模型服务（仅在有新模型或版本时变化）解耦。数据库可视为很少变化的外部依赖。这种解耦意味着每一部分都可独立升级——例如部署改进了 prompt 处理的编排器 deployment 新版本，而不动 LLM deployment 或清除任何存储数据。它还允许按各组件使用量扩缩；例如许多对话会话主要加载 LLM 与数据库，就扩它们，而编排器代码可能是轻量计算密集型，需要更少副本。

Backend AI Services
后端 AI 服务

The second pattern is a more interconnected microservices architecture where an LLM-powered service operates as part of a broader system without a direct user interface or direct request to an LLM service. Instead, the LLM logic is triggered by events or calls from other services in the platform.

第二种模式是更互联的微服务架构——LLM 驱动的服务作为更广泛系统的一部分运行，没有直接用户界面，也没有对 LLM 服务的直接请求。相反，LLM 逻辑由平台中其他服务的事件或调用触发。

Figure 8-2 represents this pattern with an AI-driven backend service performing an order risk analysis in an ecommerce platform where multiple services and stores are orchestrated together. In this example, an application orchestrator receives order events from services like Orders, Payments, and Catalog (e.g., to check product availability or pricing changes that might indicate suspicious activity). It then calls an AI risk analyzer that uses an LLM, a vector store of policy text, and past cases to evaluate the order. The analyzer may also call domain tools, such as a rules engine or fraud APIs. Finally, the orchestrator writes the decision to a risk database and emits events for downstream services like Fulfillment. This backend can be implemented synchronously with service calls or asynchronously on an event bus.

图 8-2 展示这种模式：在电商平台中，一个 AI 驱动后端服务做订单风险分析，多个服务与存储被编排在一起。本例中，应用编排器从 Orders、Payments、Catalog 等服务接收订单事件（例如检查产品可用性或可能指示可疑活动的定价变化）。然后它调用 AI 风险分析器——后者使用 LLM、策略文本向量存储与过往案例来评估订单。分析器还可能调用领域工具，如规则引擎或欺诈 API。最后编排器把决策写入风险数据库，并为 Fulfillment 等下游服务发出事件。此后端可同步用服务调用实现，也可异步在事件总线上实现。

原书第 304 页

In this event-driven architecture, the AI application subscribes to events, performs multistep analysis with an LLM, and emits results for other services:

在这种事件驱动架构中，AI 应用订阅事件，用 LLM 执行多步分析，并为其他服务发出结果：

  1. The message broker receives events like OrderPlaced or PaymentProcessed from business services. Our AI orchestrator service subscribes to the relevant events. In Kubernetes, this might be done via an event streaming platform running in the cluster, or an integration with an external bus. While Kubernetes doesn't natively provide a message queue, many cloud-native systems run on K8s for this—or you might use Knative Eventing or Dapr pub-sub components. The key is that the AI service is triggered asynchronously rather than via an HTTP request (StatefulSet).消息代理从业务服务接收 OrderPlaced 或 PaymentProcessed 等事件。我们的 AI 编排器服务订阅相关事件。在 Kubernetes 上，这可通过集群中运行的事件流平台或与外部总线的集成实现。虽然 Kubernetes 不内建消息队列，但许多云原生系统为此跑在 K8s 上——或者你可用 Knative Eventing 或 Dapr pub-sub 组件。关键是 AI 服务异步触发，而非通过 HTTP 请求（StatefulSet）。
  2. The AI Orchestrator wakes on relevant events and reacts accordingly. For instance, on an OrderPlaced event, this service might gather data from multiple sources: fetch the order details, payment history, and relevant product info, then call an AI risk analyzer component to evaluate fraud risk. The risk analyzer itself could involve an LLM call with context. In the example, the service uses an LLM plus a vector store of policy documents and past fraud cases to assess the order. It may also call non-AI tools—e.g., a rules engine or third-party fraud detection API—as part of the analysis plan. This orchestration can be thought of as an agent workflow (LLM deciding on actions and calling tools) but encapsulated within a single microservice (Deployment).AI 编排器在相关事件上唤醒并相应反应。例如收到 OrderPlaced 事件时，该服务可能从多源收集数据：拉取订单详情、支付历史、相关产品信息，然后调用 AI 风险分析器组件评估欺诈风险。风险分析器本身可能涉及带上下文的 LLM 调用。本例中，服务用 LLM 加策略文档与过往欺诈案例的向量存储来评估订单。它还可能调用非 AI 工具——如规则引擎或第三方欺诈检测 API——作为分析计划的一部分。这种编排可视为智能体工作流（LLM 决定行动并调用工具），但封装在单个微服务中（Deployment）。
  3. The LLM and tools services run as separate deployments or external APIs. Similar to the chat pattern, the LLM is often a separate deployment (or an external API) that the orchestrator calls for the generative or reasoning step. The vector database for retrieval (e.g., storing fraud cases or policies) is a StatefulSet with a PersistentVolumeClaim (PVC), acting as a knowledge base to ground the LLM's decision. Any domain-specific tools (like the rules engine) could be separate services, accessible via their own APIs. In some cases, a tool might even be implemented by triggering a Kubernetes job—for example, if you have a compute-intensive data processing step that can run asynchronously, the orchestrator might create a job for it and later collect the result. However, more commonly these tools are just HTTP/gRPC calls to other microservices. The key difference from the linear pattern described in "Chat Applications" on page 263 is that these calls are not directly user-initiated but are part of a backend flow (Deployment).LLM 与工具服务作为独立 deployment 或外部 API 运行。与对话模式类似，LLM 通常是独立 deployment（或外部 API），编排器在生成或推理步骤调用它。用于检索的向量数据库（如存储欺诈案例或策略）是带 PersistentVolumeClaim（PVC）的 StatefulSet，充当锚定 LLM 决策的知识库。任何领域专用工具（如规则引擎）可以是独立服务，通过自己的 API 访问。某些情况下，工具甚至可通过触发 Kubernetes job 实现——例如有可异步运行的计算密集数据处理步骤，编排器可能为它创建 job 之后收集结果。但更常见的是这些工具只是对其他微服务的 HTTP/gRPC 调用。与第 263 页“对话应用”中线性模式的关键区别是：这些调用不是用户直接发起的，而是后端流的一部分（Deployment）。
  4. The state outputs persist decisions to a datastore and emit new events for downstream services. In the risk analysis example, the outcome (approve/flag the order, a risk score, etc.) is written to a risk database (another StatefulSet for persistent state), and an event like OrderFlagged might be produced for downstream services (Fulfillment, Notifications) to act on. This turns the AI decision into part of the event-driven architecture of the whole system.状态输出把决策持久化到数据存储，并为下游服务发出新事件。在风险分析例子中，结果（批准/标记订单、风险评分等）写入风险数据库（另一个用于持久状态的 StatefulSet），可能产生 OrderFlagged 事件供下游服务（Fulfillment、Notifications）行动。这把 AI 决策变成整个系统事件驱动架构的一部分。
  5. The downstream services react accordingly, e.g., by halting fulfillment or triggering reviews. From a Kubernetes perspective, those downstream consumers are just other deployments or jobs that handle events.下游服务相应反应，例如中止履约或触发审查。从 Kubernetes 视角，这些下游消费者只是处理事件的其他 deployment 或 job。
原书第 305 页

This architecture follows a "short think-act-observe loop" pattern. The AI service receives an input event, uses the LLM to plan and possibly take actions, updates state, and then waits for the next input. It is effectively an autonomous agent within the microservice ecosystem, but it operates within defined guardrails and produces auditable results. The AI Orchestrator deployment could scale out horizontally if the event load is high, though coordination might be needed if events have to be processed in order. One thing to note for this pattern is idempotency and reliability. Since it's event-driven, you often want the AI service to handle duplicate events or failures gracefully. Kubernetes jobs can be useful for retryable tasks here, but if our AI Orchestrator deployment crashes or needs to update, a message queue can buffer events until a new pod is ready. This pattern can trade a bit more latency (events introduce slight delays and eventual consistency) in exchange for looser coupling and better throughput scaling. It also can be more cost-efficient: the AI Orchestrator isn't doing work unless events arrive, and you can even scale it down to zero replicas with frameworks like KEDA or Knative.

这种架构遵循“短 think-act-observe 循环”模式。AI 服务接收输入事件，用 LLM 计划并可能采取行动，更新状态，然后等待下一个输入。它实际上是微服务生态中的自治智能体，但在定义的护栏内运行并产生可审计结果。事件负载高时 AI 编排器 deployment 可水平扩缩，但如果事件必须按顺序处理可能需要协调。这种模式要注意幂等性与可靠性。由于事件驱动，你常希望 AI 服务优雅处理重复事件或失败。Kubernetes job 对可重试任务有用，但如果 AI 编排器 deployment 崩溃或需要更新，消息队列可缓冲事件直到新 Pod 就绪。这种模式可用稍多延迟（事件引入轻微延迟与最终一致性）换取更松耦合与更好吞吐扩缩。它还可能更具成本效益：AI 编排器只在事件到达时工作，甚至可用 KEDA 或 Knative 等框架把它缩到零副本。

From a release perspective, this pattern usually involves many moving parts that can be updated independently, much like in the chat application pattern. The orchestrator code might be updated as business logic or policies change. The LLM serving stack might change when a new model or more optimized serving solution is adopted (for example, moving from one model to a larger one, or switching to a distributed serving approach for scale). Data stores and message brokers have their own upgrade paths. Designing clear interfaces (event schemas, API contracts) between these components is crucial so that you can upgrade one service without breaking the whole pipeline—which again echoes traditional microservice best practices, now applied to LLM-centric functionality.

从发布角度，这种模式通常涉及许多可独立更新的活动部件，很像对话应用模式。编排器代码随业务逻辑或策略变化而更新。LLM 服务栈在采用新模型或更优化服务方案时变化（例如从一个模型换到更大模型，或为规模切换到分布式服务方式）。数据存储与消息代理有自己的升级路径。在这些组件间设计清晰接口（事件 schema、API 契约）至关重要，这样升级一个服务不会破坏整条流水线——这再次呼应传统微服务最佳实践，现在应用到以 LLM 为中心的功能上。

This AI backend microservice architecture also has several variations that are not tied to an immediate external stimulus as with this event-driven approach.

这种 AI 后端微服务架构还有几种变体，不像事件驱动方式那样与即时外部刺激绑定。

Those headless services also can run asynchronously on their own or be part of larger background workflows. These variations include scheduled jobs, long-running agent loops, or on-demand batch tasks.

这些无头服务也可自己异步运行，或作为更大后台工作流的一部分。这些变体包括定时作业、长时间运行的智能体循环、或按需批任务。

原书第 306 页

Scheduled batch jobs
定时批作业

To kick off ingestion, nightly summaries, or periodic fine-tuning, use CronJobs that update vector stores or derived artifacts. Figure 8-3 shows a simple setup that uses a CronJob to fire up an ingestion job.

要启动摄取、夜间摘要或定期微调，使用更新向量存储或派生物的 CronJob。图 8-3 展示用 CronJob 启动摄取作业的简单设置。

The document ingestion phase of a retrieval-augmented generation pipeline that we describe in "Document Ingestion" on page 278 is a good example: you could have a CronJob that periodically processes new documents, generates embeddings, and updates the vector store (rather than running that in the request path). This improves efficiency and keeps the user-facing parts fast.

我们在第 278 页“文档摄取”中描述的 RAG 流水线的文档摄取阶段就是好例子：你可以用 CronJob 定期处理新文档、生成嵌入、更新向量存储（而非在请求路径中运行）。这提升效率并保持面向用户部分快速。

A typical batch job sequence works as follows:

典型批作业序列如下：

  1. An external data source provides datasets or worklists that are pulled in by the CronJob. This could be files dropped in object storage, API endpoints with new data, or simple time-based triggers.外部数据源提供数据集或工作清单，由 CronJob 拉取。这可以是丢在对象存储中的文件、带新数据的 API 端点，或简单的基于时间的触发。
  2. The CronJob schedules the batch processing on a regular interval (e.g., nightly, hourly). The CronJob resource creates job instances at the specified times. Each job runs independently and can be configured with retry policies and resource limits (CronJob).CronJob 按固定间隔（如夜间、每小时）调度批处理。CronJob 资源在指定时间创建 job 实例。每个 job 独立运行，可配置重试策略与资源限制（CronJob）。
  3. The batch worker job executes the processing logic. The job could run a batch script that loads data, invokes the LLM (perhaps calling a model API or running a local smaller model), writes results (e.g., to a file or database), then exits. Because no user is waiting, you might schedule these for off-peak hours or lower-priority nodes to reduce cost. The job completes and releases resources when finished (Job).批 worker job 执行处理逻辑。job 可运行批脚本：加载数据、调用 LLM（可能调用模型 API 或运行本地小模型）、写结果（如到文件或数据库）、然后退出。因为没有用户等待，你可把这些调度到非高峰时段或低优先级节点以降低成本。job 完成后释放资源（Job）。
  4. The LLM service performs inference as requested by the batch worker. The batch job calls the same LLM deployment used by other parts of the system, ensuring consistent model serving (Deployment).LLM 服务按批 worker 请求执行推理。批作业调用系统其他部分使用的同一 LLM deployment，确保模型服务一致（Deployment）。
  5. The vector store holds embeddings or indexed data that the batch job updates. For example, document ingestion jobs generate embeddings and store them here for later retrieval during query time (StatefulSet + PVC).向量存储保存批作业更新的嵌入或索引数据。例如文档摄取作业生成嵌入并存于此，供查询时检索（StatefulSet + PVC）。
原书第 307 页
  1. The results database stores the outcomes of batch processing. This could be summaries, classifications, or other derived data that downstream systems can query (StatefulSet + PVC).结果数据库保存批处理的产出。这可以是摘要、分类或下游系统可查询的其他派生数据（StatefulSet + PVC）。
  2. The external object storage may receive reports, artifacts, or files generated by the batch job. These outputs can be consumed by other systems or made available for download.外部对象存储可能接收批作业生成的报告、制品或文件。这些产出可被其他系统消费或提供下载。

For scheduled or triggered batch jobs, Kubernetes CronJobs and Jobs are the natural workload primitives. They provide failure retries, logs of each run, and isolation of resources per run. For example, you might allocate a larger memory or GPU for a nightly job without keeping that allocation all day.

对定时或触发的批作业，Kubernetes CronJob 与 Job 是自然负载原语。它们提供失败重试、每次运行日志、每次运行的资源隔离。例如你可以为夜间作业分配更大内存或 GPU，而不必全天保持该分配。

Continuous control loops
持续控制循环

An alternative to time-based triggers, control loops run continuously, watching for certain conditions or iteratively working on a task. Figure 8-4 shows an example of such a polling asynchronous setup.

基于时间触发的替代方案是控制循环——持续运行、观察某些条件或迭代处理任务。图 8-4 展示这种轮询异步设置的例子。

For instance, consider an ambient agent, as described in "Ambient Agents" on page 298, that monitors a data stream (logs, social media, IoT sensor readings) and whenever it notices an anomaly or a keyword, it uses an LLM to analyze and perhaps trigger an alert. Unlike the event-driven microservice use case laid out in Figure 8-2, this agent may poll for work in a loop (polling a source or awaiting callbacks) rather than react to pushed events.

例如考虑一个环境智能体（见第 298 页“环境智能体”），监控数据流（日志、社交媒体、IoT 传感器读数），每当注意到异常或关键词就用 LLM 分析并可能触发警报。与图 8-2 中事件驱动微服务用例不同，这种智能体可能在循环中轮询工作（轮询源或等待回调），而非响应推送事件。

原书第 308 页

The continuous control loop architecture works as follows:

持续控制循环架构如下：

  1. An external data feed provides the stream of data or events that the agent monitors. This could be a change feed, API endpoint, log stream, or any external source that the agent polls for new information.外部数据源提供智能体监控的数据流或事件。这可以是变更流、API 端点、日志流，或智能体轮询新信息的任何外部源。
  2. The async agent loop runs continuously in a deployment, polling the feed and deciding when to act. This agent might run as a deployment with a single replica that essentially loops: check input; if something of interest, call LLM or tools; produce an output; repeat. It's conceptually similar to how a Kubernetes controller works (continuous reconciliation loop), except here the "controller" might have an LLM in the decision process. Such an agent could also be user-facing in a passive way—for example, a Slack bot that is always connected and replies whenever a user mentions it (Deployment).异步智能体循环在 deployment 中持续运行，轮询数据源并决定何时行动。这种智能体可作为单副本 deployment 运行，本质上循环：检查输入；有感兴趣的就调用 LLM 或工具；产出输出；重复。它在概念上类似 Kubernetes 控制器的工作方式（持续调和循环），只是这里的“控制器”决策过程中可能有 LLM。这种智能体也可以被动地面向用户——例如始终连接、用户提及时回复的 Slack bot（Deployment）。
  3. The LLM service provides inference when the agent needs to analyze or generate content. The agent calls the LLM as needed based on the data it observes (Deployment).当智能体需要分析或生成内容时，LLM 服务提供推理。智能体根据观察到的数据按需调用 LLM（Deployment）。
  4. The vector store holds embeddings or reference data the agent may query, for example, policy documents, past cases, or knowledge base articles (StatefulSet + PVC).向量存储保存智能体可能查询的嵌入或参考数据，例如策略文档、过往案例、知识库文章（StatefulSet + PVC）。
  5. The results database stores the agent's decisions, actions, or observations. This provides an audit trail and allows other systems to query what the agent has done (StatefulSet + PVC).结果数据库保存智能体的决策、行动或观察。这提供审计轨迹，允许其他系统查询智能体做了什么（StatefulSet + PVC）。
  6. The external output may include artifacts, reports, or files that the agent generates. These could be stored in object storage for later retrieval.外部输出可包括智能体生成的制品、报告或文件。这些可存在对象存储中供后续检索。
  7. Notifications or webhooks allow the agent to alert external systems when it takes action, for example, sending alerts to monitoring systems or triggering downstream workflows.通知或 webhook 让智能体在采取行动时告警外部系统，例如向监控系统发送警报或触发下游工作流。

For always-on agents, a deployment as Kubernetes workload type is suitable. You may only need one replica, but you still get benefits like auto-restart on failure. If the agent should not run more than one copy, you could incorporate leader-election logic or use a singleton pattern. One simple way is to run it as a deployment with replica count 1 and ensure no autoscaling. Another approach is to use a StatefulSet of size 1, though its primary benefit, a stable network identity, is often not required for such agents. You will find more strategies for singletons in Kubernetes Patterns.

对始终在线的智能体，deployment 是合适的 Kubernetes 负载类型。你可能只需一个副本，但仍获得失败时自动重启等收益。如果智能体不应运行超过一个副本，可加入 leader 选举逻辑或使用单例模式。一个简单方式是用副本数 1 的 deployment 运行并确保不自动扩缩。另一种方式是用大小为 1 的 StatefulSet，但其主要收益——稳定网络身份——对这类智能体通常不需要。更多单例策略见 Kubernetes Patterns。

Multistep tool automation
多步工具自动化

An asynchronous workflow can also be used to accomplish a complex multistep goal without human intervention. Figure 8-5 shows a multistep agent that plans and executes a sequence of actions.

异步工作流也可用于无人干预完成复杂多步目标。图 8-5 展示一个规划并执行一系列行动的多步智能体。

For example, an agent might be tasked to generate and send a weekly summary email. Upon trigger, it will plan these steps: query a database, ask an LLM to summarize key points, maybe generate a graph via a plotting tool, and then send the email via a Simple Mail Transport Protocol (SMTP) service.

例如智能体可能被赋予生成并发送每周摘要邮件的任务。触发后它会规划这些步骤：查询数据库，请 LLM 总结要点，可能通过绘图工具生成图表，然后通过简单邮件传输协议（SMTP）服务发送邮件。

A multistep automation sequence works as follows:

多步自动化序列如下：

  1. A trigger initiates the multistep workflow. This could be a CronJob for scheduled tasks (e.g., weekly reports) or an API call for on-demand execution. The trigger starts the agent execution.触发器启动多步工作流。这可以是定时任务（如每周报告）的 CronJob，或按需执行的 API 调用。触发器启动智能体执行。
  2. The multistep agent orchestrates the entire workflow using a plan-act-observe loop. The agent maintains an internal state about its progress through the plan. It iteratively decides the next action, executes it, observes the result, and updates its plan. This could be implemented as a job that encapsulates all steps (with an internal loop for the agent planning), or as a temporary deployment that runs for the duration of the task (though a job is simpler for run-to-completion logic) (Job or Deployment).多步智能体用 plan-act-observe 循环编排整个工作流。智能体维护关于计划进展的内部状态。它迭代地决定下一行动、执行、观察结果、更新计划。这可实现为封装所有步骤的 job（带智能体规划的内部循环），或为任务期间运行的临时 deployment（不过对运行到完成的逻辑 job 更简单）（Job 或 Deployment）。
原书第 310 页
  1. The LLM service provides reasoning and generation capabilities. The agent calls the LLM multiple times during execution: to create the initial plan, to generate content (like summaries), or to decide on next steps based on observations (Deployment).LLM 服务提供推理与生成能力。智能体在执行期间多次调用 LLM：创建初始计划、生成内容（如摘要）、或根据观察决定下一步（Deployment）。
  2. The knowledge base (Vector Store) provides context and reference information. The agent may query this to ground its decisions or retrieve relevant information (StatefulSet + PVC).知识库（向量存储）提供上下文与参考信息。智能体可查询它以锚定决策或检索相关信息（StatefulSet + PVC）。
  3. The external tools enable the agent to interact with the outside world. This could include databases to query, plotting libraries to generate graphs, SMTP services to send emails, or any other APIs the agent needs to accomplish its goal. The ReAct pattern and multiagent coordination discussed in "Agentic Workflows" on page 286 fall here—they are application-level control flows within your orchestration service.外部工具让智能体与外部世界交互。这可包括要查询的数据库、生成图表的绘图库、发送邮件的 SMTP 服务，或智能体完成目标所需的任何其他 API。第 286 页“智能体工作流”中讨论的 ReAct 模式与多智能体协调就属于此类——它们是编排服务内的应用级控制流。
  4. The task state database tracks the agent's progress and decisions. This provides an audit trail of what the agent did and allows recovery if the agent needs to restart (StatefulSet + PVC).任务状态数据库跟踪智能体的进展与决策。这提供智能体做了什么的审计轨迹，并允许智能体需要重启时恢复（StatefulSet + PVC）。
  5. The notifications/external consumers receive the final output or status updates. The agent may notify external systems when the workflow completes or if it encounters issues.通知/外部消费者接收最终输出或状态更新。工作流完成或遇到问题时智能体可通知外部系统。

The key characteristic is that these agents do not map to distinct Kubernetes resource kinds—you'll run them within the deployment or job workloads. Architecturally, you must decide whether each multistep process runs synchronously (holding open a user request) or asynchronously (off the request path). Often, it's safer to run long multistep agents asynchronously and then notify the user or system when done.

关键特征是这些智能体不映射到不同的 Kubernetes 资源种类——你在 deployment 或 job 负载中运行它们。架构上，你必须决定每个多步过程是同步运行（保持用户请求打开）还是异步运行（在请求路径之外）。通常更安全的是异步运行长多步智能体，完成后通知用户或系统。

Asynchronous patterns allow you to be more flexible with resource usage. If something isn't urgent, you can run it at lower priority or when capacity is available. For example, if using spot instances or spare cycles, you might schedule noncritical LLM jobs there. Conversely, if an ambient agent is critical (say, watching for security intrusions), you treat it like any important service: ensure it's highly available and fast enough, which might mean dedicating a pod that keeps an LLM model loaded in memory. Always-on agents incur constant cost since the pod runs continuously, whereas event-triggered jobs incur cost only per use—a classic trade-off between cost efficiency and responsiveness. We need to set those lifecycle boundaries intentionally: which processes can be spun up on demand (to save money) versus which must be pre-warmed and waiting (to meet latency targets).

异步模式让你在资源使用上更灵活。如果事情不紧急，可以更低优先级或容量可用时运行。例如使用 spot 实例或空闲周期时，可把非关键 LLM 作业调度到那里。相反，如果环境智能体很关键（如监控安全入侵），你像对待任何重要服务一样对待它：确保高可用且足够快，可能意味着专用一个保持 LLM 模型在内存中加载的 Pod。始终在线的智能体因 Pod 持续运行而产生持续成本，而事件触发作业只在每次使用时产生成本——这是成本效率与响应性之间的经典权衡。我们需要有意设定这些生命周期边界：哪些进程可按需拉起（省钱），哪些必须预热等待（满足延迟目标）。

原书第 311 页

Now that we have covered popular architectural choices for designing AI-infused applications, let's focus on the AI Orchestrator component that is central to any AI application architecture. For that we will revisit the popular concepts, starting with a technique for grounding LLMs in your domain data.

介绍了设计 AI 应用的流行架构选择后，我们聚焦 AI 应用架构核心的 AI 编排器组件。为此我们重温流行概念，从用领域数据锚定 LLM 的技术开始。

Retrieval-Augmented Generation
检索增强生成

Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) is a design pattern that grounds an LLM's output in external data by fetching relevant information at inference time and including it in the prompt. Instead of relying solely on the model's fixed training data, we give the model an "open book" during question answering. The result is fewer hallucinations and answers that reflect the latest, domain-specific knowledge, even when the base model's training data is stale. We introduced RAG briefly in Chapter 6 as an alternative to model customization; here we dive deeper into its implementation on Kubernetes.

检索增强生成（RAG）是一种设计模式，通过在推理时获取相关信息并包含在 prompt 中来锚定 LLM 输出。我们不依赖模型固定的训练数据，而是在问答时给模型一本“开卷书”。结果是更少幻觉，答案反映最新的领域特定知识，即使基础模型训练数据已过时。我们在第 6 章简要介绍 RAG 作为模型定制的替代；这里深入其在 Kubernetes 上的实现。

It helps to contrast RAG with fine-tuning, which we covered in Chapter 6. Fine-tuning teaches new information to a model by updating its weights and is ideal for style, tone, or stable domain patterns you want embedded in the model. However, fine-tuning is resource-intensive and slow, and you must repeat it whenever you have new data. RAG sidesteps retraining by injecting knowledge at query time. You update a vector database with new documents, and the next user query can immediately retrieve and use that information. This makes RAG flexible for dynamic knowledge bases or rapidly changing content, and this is a big reason why it is popular in enterprises.

把 RAG 与第 6 章讨论的微调对比是有帮助的。微调通过更新权重向模型教授新信息，适合你想嵌入模型的风格、语气或稳定领域模式。但微调资源密集且缓慢，每次有新数据都必须重复。RAG 通过在查询时注入知识来回避重训练。你用新文档更新向量数据库，下一个用户查询立即可检索并使用该信息。这使 RAG 对动态知识库或快速变化的内容很灵活，也是它在企业中流行的重要原因。

RAG and model tuning are complementary rather than mutually exclusive. If you have core knowledge that rarely changes, a smaller fine-tuned model can bake in those basics and reduce prompt size. Meanwhile, RAG supplies current or user-specific data that falls outside the model's built-in knowledge. As seen in Chapter 5, large context windows have memory and latency costs, so minimizing prompt size is beneficial. In practice, many teams combine both: bake long-lived knowledge into a tuned model, and use RAG for dynamic or user-specific facts. By offloading static knowledge into the model via tuning and pulling in only relevant facts via RAG, you balance accuracy and efficiency.

RAG 与模型调优是互补而非互斥的。如果你有很少变化的核心知识，更小的微调模型可以把这些基础烤进去并减小 prompt 大小。同时 RAG 提供超出模型内建知识的当前或用户特定数据。如第 5 章所见，大上下文窗口有内存与延迟成本，所以最小化 prompt 大小有益。实践中许多团队两者结合：把长寿命知识烤进调优模型，用 RAG 提供动态或用户特定事实。通过把静态知识经调优卸载到模型、经 RAG 只拉相关事实，你平衡精度与效率。

The key is that RAG works with any base model, whether original or fine-tuned, because it operates purely through the prompt interface. All prompt-based techniques such as RAG or tool usage are compatible with a fine-tuned model as the LLM backend.

关键是 RAG 适用于任何基础模型——无论是原始还是微调——因为它纯通过 prompt 接口操作。所有基于 prompt 的技术（如 RAG 或工具使用）都与作为 LLM 后端的微调模型兼容。

RAG has two distinct phases, as illustrated in Figure 8-6. Ingestion prepares knowledge for retrieval:

RAG 有两个不同阶段，如图 8-6 所示。摄取为检索准备知识：

  • Document ingestion — prepares domain documents by parsing, chunking, embedding, and storing them in a vector database, as described in "Document Ingestion" on page 278.文档摄取——通过解析、分块、嵌入并存储到向量数据库来准备领域文档，如第 278 页“文档摄取”所述。

  • User query processing — embeds the user's prompt, retrieves similar chunks, optionally reranks, and assembles the final prompt to the LLM, as described in "User Query Processing" on page 281.用户查询处理——嵌入用户 prompt、检索相似分块、可选重排，并组装给 LLM 的最终 prompt，如第 281 页“用户查询处理”所述。

A RAG setup consists of several cooperating components. Before we learn how those components are operated on Kubernetes, let's look at their responsibilities.

RAG 设置由若干协作组件组成。在了解这些组件如何在 Kubernetes 上运营之前，先看看它们的职责。

RAG Components
RAG 组件

A typical RAG architecture comprises distinct services that map well to microservice boundaries. Figures 6-2 and 8-6 showed an overview of RAG pipelines and their core building blocks. Here we look closer at those components individually, then in "RAG on Kubernetes" on page 283 we map them to the proper Kubernetes workload types.

典型 RAG 架构包含良好映射到微服务边界的独立服务。图 6-2 与图 8-6 展示了 RAG 流水线及其核心构建块概览。这里我们逐个细看这些组件，然后在第 283 页“Kubernetes 上的 RAG”把它们映射到合适的 Kubernetes 负载类型。

These components are included in a RAG setup:

RAG 设置包含这些组件：

  • Vector database — a specialized data store for high-dimensional vectors, also called embeddings. The vector database holds your knowledge base in vector form, enabling fast nearest-neighbor search. It returns the documents or snippets most similar to a given query vector. "Vector Databases in a Nutshell" on page 277 has more details about and pointers to vector databases. In a RAG system, the vector database is the "memory" that we query for relevant context.向量数据库——专门存储高维向量（也称嵌入）的数据存储。向量数据库以向量形式保存知识库，支持快速最近邻搜索。它返回与给定查询向量最相似的文档或片段。第 277 页“向量数据库简述”有更多细节与指引。在 RAG 系统中，向量数据库是我们查询相关上下文的“记忆”。
原书第 313 页
  • Embedding model — the model that converts text or other modalities into embedding vectors during ingestion and at query time. During document ingestion, the embedding model transforms each document or document chunk into a numerical vector, which is then stored in the vector database. At query time, the same embedding model converts the user's query into a vector so we can search for similar documents by searching for other embedding vectors that are close to the query vector. The quality of these embeddings directly affects retrieval relevance. Quality here means that semantically similar documents map to vectors that are close to each other in the high-dimensional vector space. You might use an open source sentence transformer, a proprietary API (e.g., OpenAI embeddings), or even the LLM's own embedding capabilities, if available. The crucial point is to use the same embedding model for both indexing and querying. Note that the embedding model can be different from the LLM you use for generation; many production RAG systems use a specialized small embedding model for retrieval and a separate, often much larger, LLM for generating responses. Consistency is key: if you update or change the embedding model, you will likely need to re-embed your documents to maintain search accuracy.嵌入模型——在摄取与查询时把文本或其他模态转换为嵌入向量的模型。文档摄取时，嵌入模型把每个文档或文档分块转换为数值向量，然后存入向量数据库。查询时，同一嵌入模型把用户查询转换为向量，以便通过搜索接近查询向量的其他嵌入向量来查找相似文档。这些嵌入的质量直接影响检索相关性。这里的质量意味着语义相似的文档映射到高维向量空间中彼此接近的向量。你可用开源 sentence transformer、专有 API（如 OpenAI 嵌入），或在可用时用 LLM 自身的嵌入能力。关键是索引与查询使用同一嵌入模型。注意嵌入模型可与生成用 LLM 不同；许多生产 RAG 系统用专用小嵌入模型做检索，用单独的、通常大得多的 LLM 生成响应。一致性是关键：如果你更新或更换嵌入模型，可能需要重新嵌入文档以保持搜索精度。
  • Reranker — this is an optional component that improves the relevance of retrieved results. Typically, a reranker is a second-stage model or heuristic that takes the initial set of results from the vector search and orders or filters them by how useful they are likely to be for answering the query. For example, a simple approach might rank by similarity score or document metadata like recency or source trust level. More advanced setups use a cross-encoder model or even the LLM itself to score each candidate snippet in the context of the question. Incorporating a reranker can boost answer quality by ensuring only the most pertinent pieces of information get into the final prompt. The trade-off is extra complexity and latency, so whether you use a reranker depends on your application's requirements.重排器——这是可选组件，提升检索结果相关性。通常重排器是第二阶段模型或启发式方法，接收向量搜索的初始结果集，按对回答查询可能的有用程度排序或过滤。例如简单方法可按相似度分数或文档元数据（如新近度、来源信任级别）排序。更高级的设置用交叉编码器模型甚至 LLM 本身在问题上下文中给每个候选片段打分。引入重排器可提升答案质量——确保只有最相关的信息进入最终 prompt。代价是额外复杂度与延迟，是否使用重排器取决于应用需求。
原书第 314 页
  • AI Orchestrator — the AI Orchestrator is the glue of the RAG system. As we saw in "Architectural Patterns" on page 262, this central role is common to all AI-driven applications. It handles the overall query workflow. When a user's request comes in, the AI Orchestrator is responsible for calling the embedding model to embed the query, performing the vector database similarity search, optionally invoking the reranker to refine results, constructing the augmented prompt with retrieved text, calling the LLM service to get an answer, and post-processing and returning the result. The AI Orchestrator could be a custom REST API service you write, an API layer such as Llama Stack, or a local AI framework that manages chains of calls like LangChain. The AI Orchestrator also often implements any application-specific rules or guardrails, that, for instance, handle cases where no relevant documents are found or enforce that certain data sources must be included. The AI Orchestrator may also implement source attribution, tracking which document chunks were used to generate the response and returning links or IDs that point back to the original source documents. This citation tracking enhances transparency and allows users to verify information, typically by preserving chunk metadata (URLs, titles, timestamps) through the retrieval and ranking stages and including them in the final response as footnotes, inline citations, or a references list.AI 编排器——AI 编排器是 RAG 系统的粘合剂。如第 262 页“架构模式”所见，这个核心角色是所有 AI 驱动应用共有的。它处理整体查询工作流。用户请求到达时，AI 编排器负责调用嵌入模型嵌入查询、执行向量数据库相似度搜索、可选调用重排器精化结果、用检索文本构建增强 prompt、调用 LLM 服务获得答案、后处理并返回结果。AI 编排器可以是你写的自定义 REST API 服务、Llama Stack 等 API 层，或 LangChain 等管理调用链的本地 AI 框架。AI 编排器还常实现任何应用特定规则或护栏——例如处理未找到相关文档的情况，或强制必须包含某些数据源。AI 编排器还可实现来源归属，跟踪哪些文档分块被用于生成响应，并返回指回原始源文档的链接或 ID。这种引用跟踪提升透明度，允许用户验证信息——通常通过在检索与排序阶段保留分块元数据（URL、标题、时间戳），并在最终响应中以脚注、内联引用或参考文献列表包含它们。
  • LLM service — finally, the LLM itself is the component that generates the answer for the end user. The LLM takes the prompt assembled by the orchestrator (which includes the user's question plus retrieved context) and produces a completion. In a RAG setup, the LLM's job is constrained to generation. It doesn't need to have all knowledge internally; instead it relies on the provided context for facts. This service could be a model deployment running in your cluster, like we have described in Chapter 1, or a call to an external API like OpenAI. The LLM service should be treated like any other dependent service: you send it a request and get back a response, and the AI Orchestrator then delivers that response to the user, often after some formatting or verification.LLM 服务——最后，LLM 本身是为终端用户生成答案的组件。LLM 接收编排器组装的 prompt（包含用户问题加检索上下文）并产生补全。在 RAG 设置中，LLM 的工作限于生成。它不需要内部拥有所有知识；而是依赖提供的上下文获取事实。这个服务可以是你集群中运行的模型 deployment（如第 1 章所述），或对外部 API（如 OpenAI）的调用。LLM 服务应像任何其他依赖服务一样对待：你发请求并收回响应，AI 编排器再把响应交付给用户，常在某些格式化或验证之后。

Sidebar: Vector Databases in a Nutshell

A vector database (also called a vector store) specializes in fast similarity search so a RAG pipeline can fetch the document chunks most similar to a user's query and pass them to the LLM. Documents and queries are mapped by an embedding model to a single vector in high-dimensional space where semantic neighbors lie close together, and similarity is typically scored with cosine similarity. Cosine similarity measures how much two vectors point in the same direction. In two dimensions you can picture two arrows from the origin forming an angle theta, and cosine similarity is the cosine of that angle: 1.0 when they point the same way, 0.0 when they are perpendicular, and –1.0 when they point in opposite directions. This orientation focus is useful for text embeddings because scaling a vector does not change its meaning, while direction preserves semantics. Hybrid search combines dense vector matching with lexical ranking such as BM25 so you capture both semantic relatedness and exact-token signals. Engines typically fuse scores or run a two-stage pipeline with an optional reranker, which helps especially for rare terms, identifiers, and exact phrases while keeping semantic recall high. Modern systems accelerate search with approximate nearest-neighbor indexes and add filtering, durability, and distribution to meet production SLAs. Vector search predates LLMs in recommendations and multimedia deduplication, and breakthroughs such as HNSW graphs and FAISS made billion-scale similarity practical by trading perfect accuracy for speed. These algorithms return approximately correct results rather than guaranteed exact nearest neighbors. Popular choices of vector databases include open source databases like Milvus, Weaviate, and Qdrant, the managed service Pinecone, vector features in PostgreSQL via pgvector, and in Elasticsearch via dense vectors.

向量数据库（也称向量存储）专于快速相似度搜索，使 RAG 流水线能获取与用户查询最相似的文档分块并传给 LLM。文档与查询由嵌入模型映射到高维空间中的单个向量，语义邻居彼此靠近，相似度通常用余弦相似度评分。余弦相似度衡量两个向量在多大程度上指向同一方向。在二维中你可以想象从原点出发的两个箭头形成角度 θ，余弦相似度就是该角的余弦：同向为 1.0，垂直为 0.0，反向为 -1.0。这种朝向聚焦对文本嵌入有用，因为缩放向量不改变其含义，而方向保留语义。混合搜索把稠密向量匹配与 BM25 等词法排序结合，同时捕获语义相关性与精确 token 信号。引擎通常融合分数或运行两阶段流水线（带可选重排器），这对稀有词、标识符、精确短语尤其有帮助，同时保持高语义召回。现代系统用近似最近邻索引加速搜索，并增加过滤、持久化与分布以满足生产 SLA。向量搜索在推荐与多媒体去重中早于 LLM 出现，HNSW 图、FAISS 等突破通过用精度换速度使十亿级相似度搜索实用化。这些算法返回近似正确结果而非保证精确的最近邻。流行向量数据库包括 Milvus、Weaviate、Qdrant 等开源数据库，托管服务 Pinecone，PostgreSQL 中通过 pgvector 的向量特性，以及 Elasticsearch 中通过稠密向量的特性。
原书第 315 页

These components work together to achieve RAG. Importantly, they map well to microservice boundaries, which is useful when we later deploy on Kubernetes. For instance, the vector database might be one service, the LLM another, and so on, allowing each to scale or be managed independently. Before we get into deployment, let's now walk through the two distinct phases of a RAG pipeline: document ingestion and user query processing. Understanding these two flows will make it clearer how to build and operate RAG systems.

这些组件协同工作实现 RAG。重要的是它们良好映射到微服务边界，这在我们后续部署到 Kubernetes 时很有用。例如向量数据库可以是一个服务，LLM 是另一个，等等，让各自独立扩缩或管理。在进入部署之前，我们现在走一遍 RAG 流水线的两个不同阶段：文档摄取与用户查询处理。理解这两个流程会让如何构建与运营 RAG 系统更清晰。

Document Ingestion
文档摄取

Document ingestion is the offline process that prepares your external data so it can be used for retrieval. In this phase, we take raw documents and convert them into embeddings stored in the vector database. Think of it as building the knowledge index that your application will later query. This process can happen up front like indexing a large corpus of company documents before the app goes live and continually as new data arrives.

文档摄取是准备外部数据以供检索的离线过程。在这个阶段，我们取原始文档并转换为存入向量数据库的嵌入。把它想成构建应用稍后会查询的知识索引。这个过程可以提前进行（如应用上线前对公司文档大语料建索引），也可随新数据到达持续进行。

The ingestion pipeline runs asynchronously and independently from user query processing. There is no blocking relationship between ingestion and query handling—users can query the vector database while ingestion jobs are running, and new documents become available for retrieval as soon as their embeddings are written to the store. In Kubernetes, you implement ingestion as Jobs or CronJobs that process documents in batches. Within each ingestion job, the processing steps (parsing, chunking, embedding, storing) can run sequentially in a single container for simplicity, or be distributed across multiple worker pods using message queues when high throughput is required. The pipeline writes results incrementally to the vector database, making newly indexed documents searchable immediately without waiting for the entire batch to complete.

摄取流水线异步独立于用户查询处理运行。摄取与查询处理之间没有阻塞关系——用户可在摄取作业运行时查询向量数据库，新文档的嵌入一旦写入存储立即可供检索。在 Kubernetes 上，你把摄取实现为批量处理文档的 Job 或 CronJob。在每个摄取作业内，处理步骤（解析、分块、嵌入、存储）为简单可在单容器中顺序运行，或在需要高吞吐时用消息队列分布到多个 worker Pod。流水线增量写入向量数据库，使新索引文档立即可搜索，无需等待整批完成。

A typical ingestion pipeline involves several steps, as shown in Figure 8-7.

典型摄取流水线涉及若干步骤，如图 8-7 所示。

原书第 316 页

In detail, the steps are:

具体步骤如下：

  • Collect and parse documents — first, gather the source data you want to make available to the LLM. These could be text files, PDFs, database records, web pages, or transcripts, and you will parse each document into plain text. Often this step involves custom code or libraries to extract text from various formats. One such tool is Docling, an open source document-parsing framework designed for AI workflows that ingests heterogeneous sources such as PDFs, Word files, HTML, or scanned images and turns them into structured, machine-readable text while preserving metadata like headings or page numbers. For RAG ingestion, a consistent structured output reduces the complexity of preprocessing.收集并解析文档——首先收集你想提供给 LLM 的源数据。这可以是文本文件、PDF、数据库记录、网页或转录文本，你把每个文档解析为纯文本。这一步通常涉及自定义代码或库从各种格式提取文本。一个这样的工具是 Docling——为 AI 工作流设计的开源文档解析框架，摄取 PDF、Word 文件、HTML 或扫描图像等异构源，把它们转换为结构化、机器可读的文本，同时保留标题或页码等元数据。对 RAG 摄取，一致的结构化输出降低预处理复杂度。
  • Chunk and preprocess — it is rarely ideal to embed entire documents as one piece because they may be long or cover multiple topics. Instead, documents are usually broken into chunks of a manageable size so each chunk is topically coherent and can fit within the LLM's prompt along with the question. You might split by paragraphs or headings, or use more advanced strategies such as semantic or sentence-boundary chunking to avoid breaking context mid-thought. If you use Docling, you can derive chunks directly from document structure rather than arbitrary windows, because Docling exposes sentences, paragraphs, section headers, tables, and captions as first-class elements. Docling lets you choose chunkers by sentence, by paragraph, by header-aligned sections, or by semantic grouping, and it supports overlap and maximum-size controls so you can tune recall versus prompt budget.分块与预处理——把整个文档作为一块嵌入很少是理想的，因为它们可能很长或涵盖多个主题。相反，文档通常被分成可管理大小的分块，使每个分块主题连贯，并能与问题一起放入 LLM prompt。你可以按段落或标题切分，或使用语义/句子边界分块等更高级策略以避免在思路中间打断上下文。如果用 Docling，你可直接从文档结构推导分块而非任意窗口，因为 Docling 把句子、段落、章节标题、表格、题注暴露为一等元素。Docling 让你选择按句子、按段落、按标题对齐章节或按语义分组的分块器，并支持重叠与最大大小控制，以便在召回与 prompt 预算间调优。

  • It also emits stable identifiers and a clean metadata schema for each chunk—such as source, timestamp, version, section, and page—which preserves provenance and enables precise filtering at query time. Different chunking strategies fit different intents, with smaller, sentence-level chunks working well for FAQ-style lookup, and larger, heading-aligned segments being better for policies or manuals where broader context matters. Lifecycle management includes invalidating or re-embedding documents when they change, ensuring the vector store remains consistent. Metadata could include the source document title, date, author, section headings, or any tags that might be useful later for filtering or for letting the model identify the source.它还为每个分块发出稳定标识符与干净的元数据 schema——如来源、时间戳、版本、章节、页码——保留出处并在查询时支持精确过滤。不同分块策略适合不同意图：更小的句子级分块适合 FAQ 式查找，更大的标题对齐段节适合需要更宽上下文的策略或手册。生命周期管理包括在文档变化时使其失效或重新嵌入，确保向量存储保持一致。元数据可包括源文档标题、日期、作者、章节标题，或任何稍后用于过滤或让模型识别来源的标签。

For example, you might use the sentence transformers model all-MiniLM-L6-v2 or call a managed API such as OpenAI's text-embedding-ada-002. This step results in one vector representation for each text chunk. As noted in "RAG Components" on page 275, use the same embedding model for indexing and querying. In practice, you might run this step in batches—e.g., embedding 1,000 chunks at a time—to speed up the process using GPU or parallelism. For more background on embeddings and how they represent semantic meaning as vectors, see "Embeddings" on page xxviii.嵌入分块——接下来，每个文本分块用嵌入模型转换为数值向量，通常产生高维向量。例如你可用 sentence transformers 模型 all-MiniLM-L6-v2，或调用托管 API 如 OpenAI 的 text-embedding-ada-002。这一步为每个文本分块产生一个向量表示。如第 275 页“RAG 组件”所述，索引与查询使用同一嵌入模型。实践中你可批量运行这一步——例如一次嵌入 1000 个分块——用 GPU 或并行加速。关于嵌入及其如何把语义表示为向量的更多背景，见 xxviii 页“嵌入”。

  • Store vectors in the database — finally, insert each vector with an identifier and metadata into the vector database. The identifier links back to the original document or chunk so you can retrieve or display the source text. The metadata can include the chunk's raw text or a reference to fetch it from a content store. Some designs store only an ID and fetch the text on demand, while others store the text payload directly for fast retrieval; choose based on your latency and storage trade-offs. After this step, the vector database is populated with vectors representing your knowledge base and is ready to answer similarity queries.把向量存入数据库——最后，把每个向量连同标识符与元数据插入向量数据库。标识符链接回原始文档或分块，以便检索或展示源文本。元数据可包括分块原始文本或从内容存储获取它的引用。一些设计只存 ID 并按需取文本，另一些直接存文本负载以快速检索；根据延迟与存储权衡选择。这一步后，向量数据库填充了代表你知识库的向量，准备好回答相似度查询。

To make this concrete, imagine a support chatbot for an ecommerce platform. Your sources might include FAQ pages, product manuals, return policies, and troubleshooting guides. In ingestion, you convert PDFs and HTML to text, chunk by section, embed each chunk, and store vectors with metadata such as source: Product Manual X and section: 2.1 Installation. After ingestion, your vector store may contain tens of thousands of vectors, each representing a piece of knowledge from your documentation.

为具体说明，想象一个电商平台的支持聊天机器人。你的来源可包括 FAQ 页面、产品手册、退货政策与排错指南。摄取时，你把 PDF 与 HTML 转换为文本，按章节分块，嵌入每个分块，并用元数据存储向量，如 source: Product Manual X、section: 2.1 Installation。摄取后，你的向量存储可能包含数万个向量，每个代表文档中的一条知识。

It is worth noting that ingestion can be continuous. In a RAG system, you need a strategy to keep the vector index up-to-date. A Kubernetes CronJob can periodically fetch new or changed documents, generate embeddings, and upsert them, and you can also trigger event-driven reindexing whenever a document changes so the store evolves with your data. The operational takeaway is that the vector database content is not static—it should evolve along with your data, and your platform should include the necessary jobs or processes to manage that evolution.

值得注意的是摄取可以是连续的。在 RAG 系统中，你需要策略保持向量索引最新。Kubernetes CronJob 可定期获取新的或变化的文档、生成嵌入、upsert 它们；你还可在文档变化时触发事件驱动的重新索引，使存储随数据演进。运维要点是：向量数据库内容不是静态的——它应随数据演进，你的平台应包含管理这种演进所需的作业或进程。

Now that the document chunks are in a vector database, let's look at how to use similarity queries to assemble the RAG context for answers.

现在文档分块已在向量数据库中，我们看看如何用相似度查询组装 RAG 上下文以生成答案。

User Query Processing
用户查询处理

Once the vector database is loaded with knowledge, the RAG system can serve user queries. The query processing pipeline runs every time a new question or request comes in. Its job is to fetch the most relevant pieces of knowledge for that query, incorporate them into the LLM's prompt, and return the model's answer. Let's break down the steps in this inference-time pipeline.

向量数据库加载知识后，RAG 系统就能服务用户查询。查询处理流水线在每次新问题或请求到达时运行。它的工作是为该查询获取最相关的知识片段、把它们纳入 LLM prompt、返回模型答案。我们拆解这个推理时流水线的步骤。

Figure 8-8 shows the user query processing pipeline components.

图 8-8 展示用户查询处理流水线组件。

原书第 319 页

Here are the components of the user query processing pipeline:

用户查询处理流水线的组件如下：

  • User query arrives — a user or an upstream service asks a question or makes a request that the LLM should handle, for example, "How do I reset my device?" This query hits the application's API and the orchestrator component takes over.用户查询到达——用户或上游服务提出 LLM 应处理的问题或请求，例如“如何重置我的设备？”这个查询到达应用 API，编排器组件接管。
  • Embed the query — the orchestrator uses the same embedding model as in ingestion to encode the user's query into a vector. This is typically a fast operation and yields a query embedding in the same vector space as the document embeddings.嵌入查询——编排器用与摄取相同的嵌入模型把用户查询编码为向量。这通常是快速操作，在与文档嵌入相同的向量空间中产生查询嵌入。
  • Vector search for relevant docs — using the query embedding, the orchestrator performs a similarity search in the vector database. The store returns the top-k nearest neighbors by cosine similarity or distance, often along with metadata and, depending on configuration, the stored text payload. You can apply metadata filters or hybrid retrieval with a lexical scorer to capture rare terms, identifiers, or exact phrases while maintaining semantic recall.向量搜索相关文档——编排器用查询嵌入在向量数据库中执行相似度搜索。存储按余弦相似度或距离返回 top-k 最近邻，通常连同元数据，以及（取决于配置）存储的文本负载。你可应用元数据过滤或用词法评分器做混合检索，在保持语义召回的同时捕获稀有词、标识符或精确短语。
  • Rerank or filter results — optionally, a reranker scores each retrieved chunk in the context of the query so you can keep only the best few within your prompt budget. Simple heuristics like minimum similarity thresholds or recency boosts also help, and many systems do well with vector search alone when latency budgets are tight. By the end of this step you have a small set of context snippets ready to augment the prompt.重排或过滤结果——可选地，重排器在查询上下文中给每个检索分块打分，以便在 prompt 预算内只保留最好的几个。最小相似度阈值或新近度提升等简单启发式也有帮助，延迟预算紧张时许多系统仅靠向量搜索就表现良好。这一步结束时你有一小段上下文片段准备增强 prompt。
  • Construct the prompt with retrieved context — the orchestrator prepares the final prompt, inserting the retrieved texts and the question into a template. Example 8-1 shows one such template. The exact wording of the prompt and how the context is presented can be tuned as needed. The key is that we ground the model by giving it facts to work from, for example, a paragraph from the manual that contains the reset steps. In our example, the context might include a paragraph from the manual about resetting, which contains the specific steps.用检索上下文构建 prompt——编排器准备最终 prompt，把检索文本与问题插入模板。例 8-1 展示一个这样的模板。prompt 的确切措辞与上下文呈现方式可按需调优。关键是我们通过给模型提供事实依据来锚定它，例如手册中包含重置步骤的段落。在我们的例子中，上下文可能包含手册中关于重置的段落，其中有具体步骤。
原书第 320 页

Example 8-1. Example template to build up the prompt from RAG documents

Use the following context to answer the question.
If the context doesn't have the answer,
say you don't know.

Context:
{retrieved_text}

Question: {user_question}
Answer:
  • 由向量存储检索到的文档替换占位符。
  • 用实际用户查询替换参数。
  • LLM generates an answer — the orchestrator sends the composed prompt to the LLM service via an API call to the model inference server. The LLM processes the prompt and produces a completion—in this case, hopefully a step-by-step answer explaining how to reset the device, drawn from the provided context. Because we included the relevant snippet, the model doesn't have to invent facts; it just has to articulate the answer in natural language. The output for our example might be something like: "To reset your device, first hold down the power button for 10 seconds until the LED blinks," which mirrors the documentation and is formulated by the LLM.LLM 生成答案——编排器通过 API 调用把组装好的 prompt 发给 LLM 服务（模型推理服务器）。LLM 处理 prompt 并产生补全——本例中希望是解释如何重置设备的分步答案，来自提供的上下文。因为我们包含了相关片段，模型不必编造事实；它只需用自然语言表达答案。我们例子的输出可能是：“要重置设备，先按住电源键 10 秒直到 LED 闪烁”——这与文档一致，由 LLM 表述。
  • Post-process and return the response — the orchestrator post-processes the model output before returning it to the caller. Typical steps include formatting, attaching source citations from metadata, enforcing guardrails, and truncating to size limits. The final answer is delivered back through the API or UI.后处理并返回响应——编排器在把模型输出返回调用方之前后处理它。典型步骤包括格式化、从元数据附加来源引用、执行护栏、截断到大小限制。最终答案通过 API 或 UI 交付回去。

From the user's perspective, this pipeline is invisible: they simply get a helpful answer that references the right information. Vector search is usually fast enough that LLM generation dominates latency, so a well-implemented RAG pipeline still feels like real time. If no strong context is found, the AI Orchestrator should abstain gracefully rather than risk a hallucinated answer. With these steps in place, the LLM's response is grounded in your knowledge base and remains aligned with up-to-date facts.

从用户角度，这个流水线是不可见的：他们只是得到引用正确信息的有用答案。向量搜索通常足够快，LLM 生成主导延迟，所以实现良好的 RAG 流水线仍感觉实时。如果没找到强上下文，AI 编排器应优雅放弃，而非冒幻觉答案的风险。有了这些步骤，LLM 响应锚定在你的知识库中，并与最新事实保持一致。

Now that we have all the ingredients of a RAG system, let's see how we can map the individual RAG components to Kubernetes primitives.

现在我们有了 RAG 系统的所有要素，看看如何把各 RAG 组件映射到 Kubernetes 原语。

RAG on Kubernetes
Kubernetes 上的 RAG

Let's map the components from "RAG Components" on page 275 onto Kubernetes and show how to operate them as one production-grade system. A production RAG stack is a set of cooperating services with distinct lifecycles and SLOs that fit cleanly into Deployments, StatefulSets, Services, and Jobs. Kubernetes lets you scale each piece independently, roll out safely, and standardize configuration and security across environments.

我们把第 275 页“RAG 组件”中的组件映射到 Kubernetes，并展示如何作为一个生产级系统运营它们。生产 RAG 栈是一组协作服务，有不同生命周期与 SLO，干净地落入 Deployment、StatefulSet、Service 与 Job。Kubernetes 让你独立扩缩每一部分、安全发布、跨环境标准化配置与安全。

Now let's examine Kubernetes support for each component in more depth and, where it adds clarity, point to the associated patterns in Kubernetes Patterns:

现在我们更深入地检查每个组件的 Kubernetes 支持，并在清晰处指向 Kubernetes Patterns 中的相关模式：

  • Vector database — the vector store is the backbone of retrieval, and on Kubernetes it belongs in a StatefulSet with a PersistentVolumeClaim per replica, so shards have stable identities and data persists across restarts. If the vendor offers an operator, adopt it to encapsulate cluster setup and upgrades, and size memory so hot indexes stay resident while enabling approximate nearest neighbor (ANN) indexes for scale. Expose it on a cluster-internal service and use NetworkPolicies to restrict which pods can connect, then treat it like any critical database with snapshots and tested restores. This maps directly to the Stateful Service and Service Discovery patterns.向量数据库——向量存储是检索的骨干，在 Kubernetes 上它属于每个副本带 PersistentVolumeClaim 的 StatefulSet，使分片有稳定身份、数据跨重启持久。如果厂商提供 operator，采用它以封装集群搭建与升级，并规划内存使热索引保持驻留，同时启用近似最近邻（ANN）索引以支持规模。通过集群内部服务暴露它，用 NetworkPolicy 限制哪些 Pod 可连接，然后像任何关键数据库一样对待它——做快照与经过测试的恢复。这直接映射到有状态服务与服务发现模式。
  • Embedding service — embedding models can be deployed in different ways, depending on your performance and operational needs. The most common production setup is to serve embeddings through a lightweight model server packaged as a deployment, which allows you to scale it independently and allocate either CPU or GPU resources as needed. For small, efficient models it may be simpler to embed directly in-process within the orchestrator, avoiding a network hop and keeping latency low. A middle ground is a sidecar in the orchestrator pod to share fate while versioning the model independently, as shown in Figure 8-9. The key is consistency between ingestion-time and query-time encoding, and the sidecar pattern fits well when you need a local helper without coupling builds. Some databases can generate embeddings in the database at write or query time; for example, Weaviate's vectorizer modules can embed on write operations and at query, and Postgres with pgvector can drive automatic embedding via SQL triggers and extensions. This keeps ingestion and retrieval encoders aligned but increases coupling between the database and model choice. Whichever pattern you use, enforcing a single embedding model and configuration for both ingestion and query-time encoding is crucial.嵌入服务——嵌入模型可按性能与运维需要以不同方式部署。最常见的生产设置是通过打包为 deployment 的轻量模型服务器服务嵌入，让你独立扩缩它并按需分配 CPU 或 GPU 资源。对小而高效的模型，在编排器进程内直接嵌入可能更简单——避免网络跳变并保持低延迟。折中是在编排器 Pod 中用 sidecar，共享命运同时独立版本化模型，如图 8-9 所示。关键是摄取时与查询时编码的一致性，sidecar 模式在你需要本地 helper 而不耦合构建时很合适。一些数据库可在写入或查询时在库内生成嵌入；例如 Weaviate 的 vectorizer 模块可在写入操作与查询时嵌入，Postgres 加 pgvector 可通过 SQL 触发器与扩展驱动自动嵌入。这保持摄取与检索编码器对齐，但增加数据库与模型选择之间的耦合。无论用哪种模式，对摄取与查询时编码强制单一嵌入模型与配置都至关重要。
原书第 322 页
  • AI Orchestrator — the orchestrator is the "brain" that encodes the query, retrieves, optionally reranks, constructs the prompt, and calls the LLM, so run it as a stateless deployment exposed through a ClusterIP service or, if it faces end users, through an ingress or API gateway. Because it coordinates multiple dependencies, the orchestrator should be carefully instrumented: propagate trace context across calls so you can measure end-to-end latency and identify bottlenecks. Configurations such as prompt templates, thresholds, or retrieval parameters should live in ConfigMaps so you can tune them without code changes. Credentials should be mounted from secrets to keep them safe. The Secure Configuration pattern has more information on how you can harden secret configuration. Scale with the horizontal pod autoscaler for steady load, and use Knative or KEDA when you need event-driven bursts or scale-to-zero for idle paths. Check out the Elastic Scale pattern to learn more about Knative and KEDA, and how it supports up and down scaling, including scale to zero.AI 编排器——编排器是编码查询、检索、可选重排、构建 prompt、调用 LLM 的“大脑”，所以作为无状态 deployment 运行，通过 ClusterIP 服务暴露；如果面向终端用户，通过 Ingress 或 API 网关暴露。因为它协调多个依赖，编排器应被仔细埋点：跨调用传播 trace 上下文，以便测量端到端延迟并识别瓶颈。prompt 模板、阈值、检索参数等配置应放在 ConfigMap 中，以便不改代码就能调优。凭证应从 secret 挂载以保安全。安全配置模式有更多关于如何加固 secret 配置的信息。对稳定负载用水平 Pod 自动扩缩器扩缩；需要事件驱动突发或空闲路径缩到零时用 Knative 或 KEDA。弹性扩缩模式有更多关于 Knative 与 KEDA 及其支持上下扩缩（包括缩到零）的信息。

  • Reranker (optional) — if precision matters, run a cross-encoder or heavier reranker as its own deployment and call it selectively for high-stakes queries to balance cost and latency. Simple heuristics can stay in the orchestrator, but a separate service lets you tune resources and release cadence independently, following the Stateless Service pattern. Keeping the reranker optional allows you to balance cost and quality, enabling you to switch it on for high-stakes queries while letting most traffic flow through the faster path.重排器（可选）——如果精度重要，把交叉编码器或更重重排器作为自己的 deployment 运行，选择性地为高风险查询调用它，以平衡成本与延迟。简单启发式可留在编排器中，但独立服务让你独立调优资源与发布节奏，遵循无状态服务模式。保持重排器可选让你平衡成本与质量——为高风险查询开启它，而让大部分流量走更快路径。
  • Batch ingestion jobs — document ingestion is not a one-time event but an ongoing process, and Kubernetes is well suited to running this work in the background. You can schedule ingestion with CronJobs that periodically fetch new or updated sources; parse, chunk, and embed them; and then upsert results into the vector database. For near-real-time pipelines, event-driven jobs can be triggered by file uploads or database updates. Document ingestion can also be modeled nicely as an endpoint of an Event Mesh as offered by Knative Eventing. Use resource requests and limits so that ingestion workloads do not starve user-facing services, and separate the namespaces or node pools if you need stricter isolation. By treating ingestion as a first-class workload, with monitoring and retries, you ensure that the vector database is fresh and your RAG system reflects the latest state of your domain. Technical details can be found in the Batch Job and Periodic Job patterns.批摄取作业——文档摄取不是一次性事件而是持续过程，Kubernetes 很适合在后台运行这项工作。你可用 CronJob 调度摄取：定期获取新的或更新的源；解析、分块、嵌入；然后 upsert 结果到向量数据库。对近实时流水线，事件驱动作业可由文件上传或数据库更新触发。文档摄取还可很好地建模为 Knative Eventing 提供的 Event Mesh 的端点。使用资源请求与限制，使摄取负载不饿死面向用户的服务；如果需要更严格隔离，分离命名空间或节点池。通过把摄取视为一等负载（带监控与重试），你确保向量数据库新鲜、RAG 系统反映领域最新状态。技术细节见批作业与定时作业模式。
