With RAG we saw how to ground LLMs in trusted knowledge and operate the supporting components on Kubernetes. We now turn to agentic workflows, where the model not only consumes context but also plans actions, chooses tools, and iterates toward goals in short think-act-observe loops.

通过 RAG 我们看到如何用可信知识锚定 LLM 并在 Kubernetes 上运营支持组件。现在转向智能体工作流——模型不仅消费上下文，还在短 think-act-observe 循环中规划行动、选择工具、朝目标迭代。

Agentic Workflows
智能体工作流

Agentic apps wrap the inference calls to a model in a small control loop that can plan, call tools, observe results, and iterate until a goal is met.

智能体应用把对模型的推理调用包裹在一个小控制循环中，该循环能规划、调用工具、观察结果、迭代直到目标达成。

In general, the control loop looks like Figure 8-10 and contains the following steps:

一般来说，控制循环如图 8-10 所示，包含以下步骤：

  • Perceive — read new signals: user input, tool output, and conversation state.感知——读取新信号：用户输入、工具输出、对话状态。
  • Think — plan the next step, decide whether a tool is needed, and shape the next prompt turn.思考——规划下一步，决定是否需要工具，塑造下一轮 prompt。
  • Act — execute an action: call a tool, run code, fetch data, or draft a candidate answer.行动——执行行动：调用工具、运行代码、拉取数据，或起草候选答案。
  • Observe — capture the tool result or user follow-up and normalize it to the working context.观察——捕获工具结果或用户后续输入，并归一化到工作上下文。
  • Reflect — check progress against the goal, revise plan, and decide to stop or continue.反思——对照目标检查进展，修订计划，决定停止或继续。
  • Remember — store short-term scratchpad items and long-term facts in external memory.记忆——把短期草稿项与长期事实存储到外部记忆。
原书第 325 页

This flow is a refinement of the well-known ReAct loop that we describe in the following sidebar. This loop applies for simple agents and builds the foundation for more complex scenarios involving multiagents, described in "Multiagent Systems" on page 295, and ambient agents that we explore in "Ambient Agents" on page 298.

这个流程是对下面边栏中描述的著名 ReAct 循环的精化。这个循环适用于简单智能体，并为涉及多智能体的更复杂场景（第 295 页“多智能体系统”）与环境智能体（第 298 页“环境智能体”）奠定基础。

Sidebar: The ReAct Loop

The ReAct pattern interleaves chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning with tool actions so the model can think, act, observe, and repeat in a compact loop. Originally introduced by Yao et al. in the paper "ReAct: Synergizing Reasoning and Acting in Language Models", ReAct showed that models reduce hallucinations and improve success rates when they can alternate between reasoning and calls to external sources, such as a search API. In a ReAct agent, the LLM emits intermediate thoughts and, when needed, an action with JSON arguments; the tool executes, the observation is appended to context, and the model continues until a stop condition. In production you do not expose CoT to users—you keep traces internal or replace them with summaries—but the control flow stays the same. Log each thought, action, and observation as structured records so you can debug behavior later and correlate cost with quality.

ReAct 模式把思维链（CoT）推理与工具行动交织，使模型能在紧凑循环中思考、行动、观察、重复。ReAct 由 Yao 等人在论文《ReAct：语言模型中推理与行动的协同》中首次提出，表明当模型能在推理与调用外部源（如搜索 API）之间交替时，可减少幻觉并提升成功率。在 ReAct 智能体中，LLM 发出中间思考，必要时发出带 JSON 参数的行动；工具执行，观察被追加到上下文，模型继续直到停止条件。生产中你不向用户暴露 CoT——你保持 trace 内部或用摘要替换——但控制流保持不变。把每个思考、行动、观察作为结构化记录日志，以便日后调试行为并把成本与质量关联。

Let's focus for the moment on the Act part of the agentic control loop, as it's the crucial step that allows including information that is not part of the model's training data either because it is too new or it is domain-specific information that is not accessible for the model training. These actions are commonly referred to as tools and can be anything from simple web searches to API calls to enterprise internal backend services. Tool use comes in two execution paths that you can mix in one workflow:

我们现在聚焦智能体控制循环中的 Act 部分，因为它是允许包含不属于模型训练数据信息的关键步骤——这些信息要么太新，要么是模型训练时无法访问的领域特定信息。这些行动通常称为工具，可以是从简单 Web 搜索到 API 调用到企业内部后端服务的任何东西。工具使用有两条执行路径，可在一个工作流中混合：

原书第 326 页
  • Client-executed function tools — the model emits a function call with JSON arguments: your client code performs the action and posts the result back, keyed by a call_id. This is the portable baseline for fine-grained control and audit in your control plane. Example 8-2 shows the request-response flow in which the server response asks the client to call a tool from the client side and send the result back to the server. This kind of multistep interaction requires the agentic flow to be stateful to keep the conversation history. Client-side tool calling is quite fragile, as every agentic framework expects the tool call request to be in a different format.客户端执行的函数工具——模型发出带 JSON 参数的函数调用：你的客户端代码执行行动并把结果以 call_id 为键回传。这是控制平面中细粒度控制与审计的可移植基线。例 8-2 展示请求-响应流——服务器响应要求客户端在客户端调用工具并把结果发回服务器。这种多步交互要求智能体流有状态以保持对话历史。客户端工具调用相当脆弱，因为每个智能体框架期望工具调用请求格式不同。
  • Server-executed tools — the agent runtime (such as LangChain, CrewAI, or similar frameworks) executes tools on your behalf, including remote Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers. We will dive into the Model Context Protocol standard in "The Model Context Protocol" on page 303, as it is the de facto standard these days for tool interaction. MCP allows for a much better integration of domain knowledge into the agent flow than client-side tool calling. For now it is enough to know that MCP is a protocol that facilitates tool calling and discovery substantially on the server side.服务器执行的工具——智能体运行时（如 LangChain、CrewAI 或类似框架）代表你执行工具，包括远程模型上下文协议（MCP）服务器。我们将在第 303 页“模型上下文协议”中深入 MCP 标准，因为它是当今工具交互的事实标准。MCP 比客户端工具调用更好地把领域知识集成到智能体流中。现在只需知道 MCP 是在服务器侧大幅促进工具调用与发现的协议。

Example 8-2. Client-side function calling with OpenAI's Responses API

# Initial request including description of available tools
curl https://api.openai.com/v1/responses \
  -d '{
    "input": [
      {"role": "user", "content": "Do I need an umbrella in Berlin today?"}
    ],
    "tools": [
      {
        "type": "function",
        "name": "get_weather",
        "description": "Get the weather information for a city and ISO date.",
        "parameters": {
          "type": "object",
          "properties": {
            "city": { "type": "string" },
            "date": { "type": "string", "format": "date" }
          },
          "required": ["city", "date"],
          "additionalProperties": false
        },
        "strict": true
      }
    ],
    "tool_choice": "auto"
  }'
# Part of the returned response, asking the client for a tool call
{
  ...
  "output": [
    ... ,
    {
      "type": "function_call",
      "call_id": "call_wx_1",
      "name": "get_weather",
      "arguments": "{\"city\":\"Berlin\",\"date\":\"2025-09-20\"}"
    }
  ],
  "status": "incomplete"
}
# Part of the second client request, holding the result of the tool call
curl https://api.openai.com/v1/responses \
  ...
  -d '{
    "input": [
      ...,
      {
        "type": "function_call_output",
        "call_id": "call_wx_1",
        "output":
          "{\"precipitation_chance\":0.80,
            \"summary\":\"Heavy rain expected in the afternoon.\"}"
      }
    ]
  }'
原书第 327 页
  • 初始用户查询。
  • 客户端工具的定义。
  • 服务器要求客户端调用工具的响应。
  • 把工具调用响应与其请求关联的关联 ID。
  • 返回工具调用结果的第二个请求。

Originally, client-side tool calling has been performed by the caller of the agentic loop so that it takes over the responsibility for the actual call. In this case, when the LLM decides in its reasoning phase that a tool needs to be called, based on the description and metadata that a tool exposes, it returns control to the caller, asking it to call the tool and return the results in the next step of this multiturn conversation.

最初，客户端工具调用由智能体循环的调用方执行，由它承担实际调用的责任。在这种情况下，当 LLM 在推理阶段根据工具暴露的描述与元数据决定需要调用工具时，它把控制权返回给调用方，请其调用工具并在这个多轮对话的下一步返回结果。

The rest of this chapter builds from here. In "OpenAI's Responses API" on page 291, we dig into the Responses features for state, events, and approvals. In "Agentic Frameworks and Runtimes" on page 290, we compare client-side libraries with server-side runtimes. In "Multiagent Systems" on page 295, we scale the loop across teams of agents, and in "Ambient Agents" on page 298, we make the loop event-driven on Kubernetes.

本章其余部分从此展开。在第 291 页“OpenAI Responses API”中，我们深入 Responses 在状态、事件、审批方面的特性。在第 290 页“智能体框架与运行时”中，我们比较客户端库与服务器端运行时。在第 295 页“多智能体系统”中，我们把循环扩展到智能体团队；在第 298 页“环境智能体”中，我们在 Kubernetes 上把循环事件驱动化。

Agentic Frameworks and Runtimes
智能体框架与运行时

原书第 328 页

Building an agentic workflow from scratch is challenging, so frameworks and runtimes simplify the job. Broadly, you will see client-side agentic libraries embedded in your code and server-side agentic runtimes exposed as services. We won't go into too many details here as we focus on operating agentic systems on Kubernetes. However, it is important to understand how to classify the multitude of frameworks:

从头构建智能体工作流很有挑战，所以框架与运行时简化了这项工作。广义上，你会看到嵌入代码中的客户端智能体库与作为服务暴露的服务器端智能体运行时。这里我们不深入太多细节，因为聚焦在 Kubernetes 上运营智能体系统。但理解如何分类众多框架很重要：

  • Client-side agentic frameworks — these libraries help you run the loop inside your own applications, giving you full control and easy debugging at the cost of managing orchestration. LangChain provides abstractions for prompts, memories, and tool use across Python and JavaScript, with a broad ecosystem for web search, databases, and REPLs. For Java applications, LangChain4j offers similar capabilities and has been integrated into Quarkus with native support for agentic workflows. LangGraph models agent steps as a graph, making branching and concurrent subtasks explicit and observable. CrewAI focuses on multiagent collaboration via role-based agents that message and delegate, which helps when specialization and parallelism pay off. CrewAI implements custom REST endpoints for agent communication, blurring the line between client-side and server-side orchestration. Because these libraries live in your runtime, you own the loop that calls the LLM, executes tools, feeds results back, and decides when to stop, which maximizes control while increasing complexity. In production, even these "client-side" frameworks typically are used by the orchestrator in containerized microservices on Kubernetes, subject to the same packaging, scaling, and observability practices you use for your application workloads.客户端智能体框架——这些库帮你在自己的应用内运行循环，给你完全控制与容易调试，代价是管理编排。LangChain 在 Python 与 JavaScript 上提供 prompt、记忆、工具使用的抽象，并有广泛的 Web 搜索、数据库、REPL 生态。对 Java 应用，LangChain4j 提供类似能力，并已集成进 Quarkus，原生支持智能体工作流。LangGraph 把智能体步骤建模为图，使分支与并发子任务显式且可观察。CrewAI 通过基于角色的智能体（互相消息与委派）聚焦多智能体协作，在专业化与并行有回报时有用。CrewAI 为智能体通信实现自定义 REST 端点，模糊客户端与服务器端编排的界限。因为这些库在你的运行时中，你拥有调用 LLM、执行工具、回喂结果、决定何时停止的循环，这最大化控制但增加复杂度。生产中，即使这些“客户端”框架通常也由 Kubernetes 上容器化微服务中的编排器使用，遵循你对应用负载使用的相同打包、扩缩、可观测实践。
原书第 329 页
  • Server-side agentic runtimes — bespoke backend services encapsulate the loop behind an API so a client sends one request and the backend performs multiturn reasoning and tool use. For example, OpenAI's Responses API provides stateful multiturn interactions, integrated tool usage, structured outputs, event streaming, and pause-and-resume for human-in-the-loop, so you do not have to write the orchestration loop yourself. (More about the Responses API in the next section.) The Responses API supports server-executed tools, including remote MCP tools, as well as client-executed function tools when you need to keep actions in your control plane. Llama Stack offers an open, self-hostable runtime with both an Agents API and an OpenAI-compatible endpoint, including a Responses-style flow, so you can run agentic backends on Kubernetes with your model choices. In contrast, the vLLM project works on an OpenAI-compatible server with tool calling and structured output support; check the current documentation for feature parity with the Responses API over time.服务器端智能体运行时——定制后端服务把循环封装在 API 之后，客户端发一个请求，后端执行多轮推理与工具使用。例如 OpenAI Responses API 提供有状态多轮交互、集成工具使用、结构化输出、事件流，以及人在环中的暂停-恢复，让你不必自己写编排循环。（下一节更多关于 Responses API。）Responses API 支持服务器执行工具（包括远程 MCP 工具），也支持你需要把行动留在控制平面时的客户端执行函数工具。Llama Stack 提供开放、可自托管的运行时，同时有 Agents API 与兼容 OpenAI 的端点，包括 Responses 风格流，让你在 Kubernetes 上用自己的模型选择运行智能体后端。相比之下，vLLM 项目在兼容 OpenAI 的服务器上工作，支持工具调用与结构化输出；随时间推移请查看当前文档了解与 Responses API 的功能对等。

The practical distinction is where the agent's orchestrator runs. Server-side runtimes hide the loop behind a network API, which simplifies client code and centralizes scaling and governance, while client-side frameworks keep logic local for maximum customization and composability. In practice you can mix both: use LangChain in your app while targeting a Llama Stack backend for inference and server-side tools, or keep tools local as client-executed functions even when planning happens server-side.

实践区别在于智能体的编排器在哪里运行。服务器端运行时把循环隐藏在网络 API 之后，简化客户端代码并集中扩缩与治理；客户端框架把逻辑留在本地以最大化定制与可组合性。实践中你可两者混合：在应用中用 LangChain，同时以 Llama Stack 后端做推理与服务器端工具；或即使规划在服务器端发生，也把工具作为客户端执行函数留在本地。

OpenAI's Responses API
OpenAI Responses API

OpenAI's Responses API is designed for agentic workflows in a single, stateful API call. The Responses API introduced features that simplify agent development: automatic conversation state across turns, structured outputs, integrated tool usage, streaming of intermediate tool events, and built-in error handling.

OpenAI Responses API 设计用于单个有状态 API 调用中的智能体工作流。Responses API 引入简化智能体开发的特性：跨轮自动对话状态、结构化输出、集成工具使用、中间工具事件流、内建错误处理。

You send the user input and a catalog of tools with JSON Schemas, and the service can autonomously sequence tool calls, feed observations back into the model, and return a final answer. Two execution paths can coexist in one flow. Server-side tools run within OpenAI's runtime, including tools accessed via the Model Context Protocol (MCP), and you receive streamed events and the final answer without implementing the loop client-side. We have more to say about MCP in "The Model Context Protocol" on page 303. Client-executed function tools let the model emit a tool call with name and JSON arguments; your service performs the action, and you resume by posting the result so the model can continue and finish.

你发送用户输入与带 JSON Schema 的工具目录，服务可自主排序工具调用、把观察回喂模型、返回最终答案。两条执行路径可在一个流中共存。服务器端工具在 OpenAI 运行时内运行，包括通过模型上下文协议（MCP）访问的工具，你收到流式事件与最终答案而无需在客户端实现循环。第 303 页“模型上下文协议”有更多关于 MCP 的内容。客户端执行函数工具让模型发出带名称与 JSON 参数的工具调用；你的服务执行行动，你回贴结果以恢复，让模型继续并完成。

Importantly, the Responses interface is rapidly becoming a de facto standard, formalized by the Open Responses initiative as an open specification. Several backends already implement compatible endpoints. Meta's Llama Stack ships an OpenAI-compatible interface and a Responses implementation that is usable but still in active development, enabling self-hosted agent runtimes on Kubernetes without changing client code. vLLM has introduced a Responses entry point in its OpenAI-compatible server and is progressing rapidly as of early 2026, so it's definitely worthwhile to check it out. OpenAI's own cookbook and community guides also reference vLLM offering a Responses-compatible API, underscoring the ecosystem's convergence on this contract. In parallel, LiteLLM provides a proxy that exposes a /responses endpoint and routes to multiple providers, giving teams a compatibility layer while the various servers continue to mature.

重要的是，Responses 接口正迅速成为事实标准，由 Open Responses 倡议形式化为开放规范。若干后端已实现兼容端点。Meta 的 Llama Stack 提供兼容 OpenAI 的接口与可用但仍在活跃开发的 Responses 实现，让你在 Kubernetes 上自托管智能体运行时而不改客户端代码。vLLM 在其兼容 OpenAI 的服务器中引入 Responses 入口点，截至 2026 年初进展迅速，绝对值得一看。OpenAI 自己的 cookbook 与社区指南也提到 vLLM 提供兼容 Responses 的 API，凸显生态向这个契约收敛。同时，LiteLLM 提供暴露 /responses 端点并路由到多提供商的代理，在各服务器继续成熟时为团队提供兼容层。

原书第 330 页

The takeaway is portability: you can standardize client code on the Responses API while choosing where to run the agentic loop—OpenAI's cloud, a self-hosted Llama Stack, or a vLLM-based service on your cluster—and swap as your operational needs evolve.

要点是可移植性：你可以把客户端代码标准化在 Responses API 上，同时选择在哪里运行智能体循环——OpenAI 云、自托管 Llama Stack、或你集群上基于 vLLM 的服务——并随运营需求演进而切换。

Human-in-the-loop fits naturally into this flow. You can pause on model-requested actions to ask a user for approval, collect additional inputs, or escalate to a reviewer before resuming, and you can enforce approval gates for sensitive tools so the model cannot proceed until you confirm. When using remote providers via MCP, the API can surface explicit approval requests for those calls, which gives you an auditable checkpoint before any side effect happens.

人在环中自然融入这个流。你可以在模型请求的行动上暂停，请用户批准、收集额外输入、或升级到审查者后再恢复；你可以为敏感工具强制审批门，使模型在你确认前不能继续。当通过 MCP 使用远程提供商时，API 可为这些调用呈现显式审批请求，在任何副作用发生前给你一个可审计检查点。

In short, Responses provides agentic reasoning as a service while letting you control which tools exist, which calls execute on your side, and when to require approval. The growing set of compatible backends makes it a pragmatic choice for portable agent architectures.

简而言之，Responses 把智能体推理作为服务提供，同时让你控制存在哪些工具、哪些调用在你侧执行、何时要求审批。不断增长的兼容后端集使它成为可移植智能体架构的务实选择。

Agents on Kubernetes
Kubernetes 上的智能体

In "Agentic Frameworks and Runtimes" on page 290 we categorized popular libraries and API services you can use to implement an agentic workflow. In this section we focus on deployment models for agent-enabled applications on Kubernetes and show what Kubernetes-native integrations look like in practice. We keep this high level: refer to Chapter 9 for deeper operational details.

在第 290 页“智能体框架与运行时”中，我们分类了可用于实现智能体工作流的流行库与 API 服务。本节聚焦 Kubernetes 上启用智能体的应用的部署模型，展示 Kubernetes 原生集成在实践中是什么样。我们保持高层：更深的运维细节见第 9 章。

Kubernetes is a natural home for agentic systems because it gives you composable building blocks for the orchestrator, tools, and memories.

Kubernetes 是智能体系统的自然归宿，因为它为编排器、工具、记忆提供可组合构建块。

Now let's turn to Kubernetes-native integrations that bring agents into the control plane via Custom Resource Definitions (CRDs) and controllers. As of early 2026 this space is evolving quickly, but one of the more mature projects is Kagent, originally started by Solo.io and growing in the Cloud Native Computing Foundation (CNCF) community. Kagent is a Kubernetes-native operator that lets you declare agents, tools, and exposure modes as custom resources and then reconciles them into runnable pods. It leans into protocol compatibility for tools and agent-to-agent exchange, so you can register MCP-compatible tool servers and expose A2A skills without leaving the control plane. You manage agents with the same GitOps and security practices you already use for deployments and jobs.

现在我们看看通过自定义资源定义（CRD）与控制器把智能体带入控制平面的 Kubernetes 原生集成。截至 2026 年初这个领域快速演进，但较成熟的项目之一是 Kagent——最初由 Solo.io 发起，在云原生计算基金会（CNCF）社区中成长。Kagent 是 Kubernetes 原生 operator，让你把智能体、工具、暴露模式声明为自定义资源，然后调和为可运行 Pod。它倾向工具与智能体间交换的协议兼容，让你无需离开控制平面即可注册 MCP 兼容工具服务器并暴露 A2A 技能。你用已用于 deployment 与 job 的相同 GitOps 与安全实践管理智能体。

The trimmed example in Example 8-3 shows the intent: define the reasoning loop, attach tools via MCP, and publish an A2A skill, while the operator handles pods, configuration, and status.

例 8-3 的精简示例展示了意图：定义推理循环，通过 MCP 挂载工具，发布 A2A 技能，而 operator 处理 Pod、配置与状态。

Example 8-3. Example of a Kagent agent definition

apiVersion: kagent.dev/v1alpha2
kind: Agent
metadata:
  name: k8s-a2a-agent
  namespace: kagent
spec:
  description: An example agent
  declarative:
    modelConfig: default-model-config
    systemMessage: |
      You are a helpful Kubernetes agent.
    tools:
      - type: McpServer
        mcpServer:
          name: kagent-tool-server
          kind: RemoteMCPServer
          toolNames:
            - k8s_get_resources
  a2aConfig:
    skills:
      - id: get-resources
        name: Get Resources
        inputModes: ....
        outputModes: ....
原书第 331 页
  • 对智能体配置的引用。
  • 系统 prompt。
  • 要使用的工具列表。
  • 对另一个资源 RemoteMCPServer 中声明的 MCP 服务器的引用。
  • 通过 Google A2A 协议连接的专用配置。

Sidebar: Emerging Kubernetes Agent Experiments

Two efforts that emerged in 2025 have gained traction as they move toward production readiness. First, the Kubernetes community's agent sandbox explores a controller and custom resource for isolated, stateful, singleton-style runtimes with stronger boundaries, persistent identity, and hibernation and resume. The goal is to support interactive or untrusted agent workloads that benefit from VM-like isolation, yet stay manageable as pod-shaped resources. Second, Kagenti positions itself as framework-neutral middleware with an operator and a uniform surface for agents, aiming to standardize identity, configuration, and exposure while integrating protocol bridges such as MCP and A2A. Both projects are under active development; evaluate their APIs and operational fit for your environment.

2025 年出现的两项努力在走向生产就绪中获得关注。第一，Kubernetes 社区的 agent sandbox 探索一个控制器与自定义资源，用于隔离、有状态、单例风格的运行时，带更强边界、持久身份、休眠与恢复。目标是受益于类 VM 隔离、但仍作为 Pod 形状资源可管理的交互式或不可信智能体负载。第二，Kagenti 把自己定位为框架中立中间件，带 operator 与统一智能体面，旨在标准化身份、配置、暴露，同时集成 MCP、A2A 等协议桥。两个项目都在活跃开发中；评估其 API 与对你环境的运维适配。

Not every Kubernetes agent integration leverages custom resources to define the agentic workflow. One notable example here is Llama Stack, which is a general purpose API layer for agentic applications that has support for agentic flows, including tool calling and multiturn reasoning. Llama Stack can still leverage an operator for managing the installation, but otherwise it relies on custom configuration files for configuring the backend systems that it's using to implement the agentic functionality.

并非每个 Kubernetes 智能体集成都利用自定义资源定义智能体工作流。一个 notable 例子是 Llama Stack——它是智能体应用的通用 API 层，支持智能体流，包括工具调用与多轮推理。Llama Stack 仍可利用 operator 管理安装，但其他方面依赖自定义配置文件来配置它用于实现智能体功能的后端系统。

Most agentic platforms converge on similar Kubernetes concepts despite their different approaches:

大多数智能体平台尽管方式不同，却趋同于相似的 Kubernetes 概念：

  • In most agentic platforms, custom resources and controllers extend Kubernetes to manage agents declaratively. Platforms like Kagent or Kagenti introduce CRDs that model agents as resources, letting you manage them with the same GitOps workflows you use for deployments. Controllers reconcile these resources into pods and services, bringing infrastructure-as-code benefits to AI systems. (Controller, Operator, Declarative Deployment)在大多数智能体平台中，自定义资源与控制器扩展 Kubernetes 以声明式管理智能体。Kagent 或 Kagenti 等平台引入 CRD 把智能体建模为资源，让你用与 deployment 相同的 GitOps 工作流管理它们。控制器把这些资源调和为 Pod 与服务，为 AI 系统带来基础设施即代码收益。（控制器、Operator、声明式 Deployment）
原书第 332 页
  • Long-lived stateful pods maintain conversational context across interactions. Unlike stateless services, agents often run as singleton deployments or single-replica StatefulSets to preserve session state. When scaling is needed, platforms either shard sessions across pods or externalize state to enable round-robin load balancing, borrowing patterns from stateful microservices. (Singleton Service, Stateful Service)长寿命有状态 Pod 在交互间维护对话上下文。与无状态服务不同，智能体常作为单例 deployment 或单副本 StatefulSet 运行以保留会话状态。需要扩缩时，平台要么跨 Pod 分片会话，要么外部化状态以支持轮询负载均衡，借用有状态微服务模式。（单例服务、有状态服务）
  • Batch jobs offload discrete tasks from the main agent loop for heavy lifting. When an agent needs to generate a report or process large datasets, it can submit a Kubernetes job and await the result. This separation brings automatic retries and resource isolation, similar to how ML pipelines decompose work. (Job, Periodic Job)批作业从主智能体循环卸载离散任务做重活。当智能体需要生成报告或处理大数据集时，它可提交 Kubernetes job 并等待结果。这种分离带来自动重试与资源隔离，类似 ML 流水线分解工作。（Job、定时作业）
  • Event-Driven Architecture (EDA) enables ambient agents that respond to system changes. In EDA setups agents are deployed as listeners that react to Kafka topics, Kubernetes events, or webhooks. Combined with a scaling platform like Knative Eventing or KEDA, these agents can scale from zero when idle and burst when events arrive, treating agents as reactive microservices rather than request-response endpoints. We talk more about ambient agents in "Ambient Agents" on page 298. (Elastic Scale)事件驱动架构（EDA）使能响应系统变化的环境智能体。在 EDA 设置中，智能体作为监听器部署，响应 Kafka topic、Kubernetes 事件或 webhook。结合 Knative Eventing 或 KEDA 等扩缩平台，这些智能体可在空闲时从零扩缩、事件到达时突发，把智能体当作反应式微服务而非请求-响应端点。第 298 页“环境智能体”有更多讨论。（弹性扩缩）
  • Tool integration is essential for agentic apps as it exposes capabilities through standard APIs via services. Tools run as separate deployments with ClusterIP services, and agents call them by DNS name. Many platforms adopt MCP to standardize these interfaces, allowing any MCP-compliant tool to work with any compatible agent framework. In "The Model Context Protocol" on page 303 we go into much more detail about how to operate MCP servers on Kubernetes. (Service Discovery, Declarative Deployment)工具集成对智能体应用至关重要，因为它通过服务以标准 API 暴露能力。工具作为独立 deployment 加 ClusterIP 服务运行，智能体按 DNS 名称调用它们。许多平台采用 MCP 标准化这些接口，让任何 MCP 兼容工具能与任何兼容智能体框架配合。第 303 页“模型上下文协议”有更多关于如何在 Kubernetes 上运营 MCP 服务器的细节。（服务发现、声明式 Deployment）
  • Persistent storage for memory ensures agents retain knowledge across restarts. Vector databases for long-term memory run as StatefulSets, while conversation history lives in databases with PersistentVolumes. This externalization makes ephemeral agent pods viable for stateful AI processes, following the same patterns as any data-dependent microservice. (Stateful Service)记忆的持久存储确保智能体跨重启保留知识。长期记忆的向量数据库作为 StatefulSet 运行，对话历史存在带 PersistentVolume 的数据库中。这种外部化使临时智能体 Pod 对有状态 AI 进程可行，遵循与任何数据依赖微服务相同的模式。（有状态服务）
  • Native Kubernetes security controls what agents can access and do. ServiceAccounts with restricted agent permissions, NetworkPolicies sandbox network access, and Secrets mount credentials with the least privilege. Multitenant deployments isolate agents in separate Namespaces, while admission controllers enforce resource quotas and policy compliance. (Process Containment, Secure Configuration, Access Control, Network Segmentation)原生 Kubernetes 安全控制智能体能访问与做什么。带受限智能体权限的 ServiceAccount、NetworkPolicy 沙箱化网络访问、Secret 以最小权限挂载凭证。多租户部署把智能体隔离在不同 Namespace 中，准入控制器强制执行资源配额与策略合规。（进程遏制、安全配置、访问控制、网络分段）
  • Observability stacks treat agents as measurable services. Agentic apps expose metrics for token counts and tool calls, stream verbose reasoning logs for debugging, and can generate Kubernetes Events for significant actions. When properly configured, this allows SREs to monitor agents with the same dashboards and alerts used for other services.可观测栈把智能体当作可度量服务。智能体应用暴露 token 计数与工具调用指标，流式输出详细推理日志用于调试，并可为重要操作生成 Kubernetes Event。配置正确时，这让 SRE 用与其他服务相同的仪表板与告警监控智能体。
原书第 333 页

In practice, successful agent deployment on Kubernetes combines robust containerization, careful state management, appropriate resource allocation, and comprehensive observability.

实践中，在 Kubernetes 上成功部署智能体结合了健壮容器化、谨慎状态管理、适当资源分配与全面可观测性。

The platform becomes your control plane for agentic AI, managing lifecycle and resources while agents focus on reasoning and tool orchestration. Whether you deploy a simple ReAct loop in a single container or coordinate multiagent cohorts across namespaces, as we describe in the next section, Kubernetes provides the scheduling, networking, and storage primitives to run agents reliably at scale.

平台成为你智能体 AI 的控制平面，管理生命周期与资源，而智能体专注推理与工具编排。无论你在单容器中部署简单 ReAct 循环，还是跨命名空间协调多智能体团队（如下节所述），Kubernetes 都提供可靠大规模运行智能体的调度、网络、存储原语。

Multiagent Systems
多智能体系统

Multiagent systems assemble several specialized agents that collaborate toward a goal larger than any one agent could deliver. Each agent is an autonomous service with its own prompt, tools, and guardrails, and it accesses one or more LLMs through remote APIs. This collaboration creates useful side effects: agents pass intermediate results, cross-check each other's work, and parallelize subtasks to improve both quality and throughput. Agents are scoped to independent tasks so responsibilities stay clear and coupling remains low. For example, think of a software team: a planner breaks work into steps, a coder drafts changes, and a tester verifies behavior before a final reviewer signs off. Specialization lets each agent focus on a narrow competency, while the system as a whole moves faster and with more confidence. A major benefit of this architecture is that each specialist operates with a much smaller working context than a single monolithic agent would need for the whole problem, which focuses prompts, reduces token usage, and improves accuracy. These agents coordinate through an explicit control flow so their partial results compose into a coherent outcome.

多智能体系统组装若干专用智能体，朝任何单个智能体都无法独立交付的目标协作。每个智能体是自治服务，有自己的 prompt、工具、护栏，并通过远程 API 访问一个或多个 LLM。这种协作产生有用副作用：智能体传递中间结果、互相交叉检查、并行化子任务以提升质量与吞吐。智能体被限定到独立任务，职责清晰、耦合低。例如想一个软件团队：规划者把工作拆成步骤，编码者起草变更，测试者验证行为，最后审查者签字。专业化让每个智能体聚焦狭窄能力，而整体系统更快更有信心地前进。这种架构的一大好处是每个专家用比单块式智能体解决整个问题所需小得多的工作上下文运行，这聚焦 prompt、减少 token 使用、提升精度。这些智能体通过显式控制流协调，使它们的部分结果组合成连贯产出。

原书第 334 页

The heart of a multiagent system is its coordination logic. One common pattern is a central orchestrator that assigns work to role agents and aggregates outcomes; this is the shape you see in crew-style frameworks where a facilitator routes coding questions to a coding agent and compliance questions to a policy agent. Figure 8-11 shows this setup with a central planning agent conducting multiple worker agents.

多智能体系统的核心是其协调逻辑。一种常见模式是中央编排器，把工作分配给角色智能体并聚合结果；这就是 crew 风格框架中看到的形态——协调者把编码问题路由给编码智能体，把合规问题路由给策略智能体。图 8-11 展示这种中央规划智能体指导多个 worker 智能体的设置。

An alternative is peer-to-peer coordination in which agents message one another directly, discover capabilities dynamically, and escalate or delegate without a single hub, as shown in Figure 8-12. Google's A2A protocol, discussed in "Agent-to-Agent Protocol" on page 329, formalizes this style by standardizing discovery, capability exchange via an agent card, task lifecycles, and artifact streaming across agent boundaries, which enables interop across teams and vendors.

另一种是对等协调——智能体直接互相发消息、动态发现能力、升级或委派，无需单一中心，如图 8-12 所示。Google A2A 协议（第 329 页“智能体间协议”讨论）通过标准化发现、通过 agent card 交换能力、任务生命周期、跨智能体边界的制品流来形式化这种风格，从而实现跨团队与厂商互操作。

In both models, the system succeeds or fails on the discipline of its messages—what gets shared, when, and with which guarantees—rather than on any individual prompt.

在两种模型中，系统成败取决于消息的纪律——共享什么、何时、带什么保证——而非任何单个 prompt。

原书第 335 页

On Kubernetes, you typically model each agent as a service-backed deployment and connect them synchronously over HTTP or gRPC, or asynchronously via a pub/sub messaging fabric. Alternatively, multiple agents can run in a single pod when a framework coordinates agent dialogue in process. This arrangement simplifies cross-agent state sharing and reduces latency, but it couples lifecycles and scaling so every agent scales together, which limits elasticity and is rarely a fit beyond small or tightly bound teams. For the rest of this section, we focus on a distributed design where agents collaborate over the network. Shared memory backends provide the glue for collaboration, using a vector store, a document store, or a blackboard where agents post findings, pending tasks, and artifacts for others to consume. This shared state lets the system remember what happened across agent boundaries while still isolating each agent's runtime and quota. The usual platform concerns still apply—service discovery, retries, backoffs, and circuit breakers—because agents are distributed systems in miniature. We will tie these pieces back to the protocols in "Agent-to-Agent Protocol" on page 329 so you can choose message shapes that survive versioning and team boundaries.

在 Kubernetes 上，你通常把每个智能体建模为服务支持的 deployment，通过 HTTP 或 gRPC 同步连接，或通过 pub/sub 消息 fabric 异步连接。或者，当框架在进程内协调智能体对话时，多个智能体可在单 Pod 中运行。这种安排简化跨智能体状态共享并降低延迟，但它耦合生命周期与扩缩——每个智能体一起扩缩，限制弹性，除了小或紧密绑定的团队外很少适合。本节其余部分聚焦智能体跨网络协作的分布式设计。共享内存后端提供协作粘合剂——用向量存储、文档存储或黑板，智能体在上面发布发现、待办任务、制品供他人消费。这种共享状态让系统跨智能体边界记住发生了什么，同时仍隔离每个智能体的运行时与配额。通常的平台关切仍适用——服务发现、重试、退避、断路器——因为智能体是微型分布式系统。我们会在第 329 页“智能体间协议”中把这些与协议关联，以便你选择能经受版本化与团队边界的消息形态。

A concrete example of a multiagent system is customer support automation: one agent monitors incoming support tickets, then delegates each ticket to an appropriate specialized agent—say, a NetworkTroubleshooter agent or a BillingInquiry agent—and finally a Summary agent compiles a report of what was done. The coordination logic decides which specialist agent gets involved and when the process is done. Multiagent systems shine in such scenarios, but they also introduce complexity in ensuring all agents work in harmony and don't step on each other's toes. Careful design of roles, communication channels, and fail-safes (for example, what if two agents disagree?) is required. One useful pattern from distributed systems is the Saga pattern, which handles long-running workflows with compensation logic for failures. In multiagent orchestration, you can apply this: if an agent fails mid-workflow, a compensating agent can roll back or clean up partial work, much like how Sagas manage distributed transactions. This gives you explicit rollback paths instead of leaving your multiagent system in an inconsistent state.

多智能体系统的一个具体例子是客户支持自动化：一个智能体监控进来的支持工单，然后把每个工单委派给合适的专用智能体——比如 NetworkTroubleshooter 智能体或 BillingInquiry 智能体——最后 Summary 智能体编译做了什么的报告。协调逻辑决定哪个专家智能体介入以及流程何时完成。多智能体系统在这类场景中表现出色，但也引入确保所有智能体和谐工作、互不踩脚的复杂性。需要仔细设计角色、通信通道、故障安全（例如两个智能体意见不一致怎么办？）。分布式系统中一个有用模式是 Saga 模式——用补偿逻辑处理长时间运行工作流的失败。在多智能体编排中你可以应用它：如果智能体在工作流中途失败，补偿智能体可回滚或清理部分工作，很像 Saga 管理分布式事务。这给你显式回滚路径，而非让多智能体系统处于不一致状态。

In summary, multiagent is collaborative intelligence. You compose small, sharp agents and add a coordination layer—centralized or peer-to-peer—and back them with shared memory that preserves context and evidence. Done well, this is agent orchestration in the literal sense: many instruments, one score, and clear cues.

总之，多智能体就是协作智能。你组合小而锋利的智能体，加一层协调——集中式或对等式——并用保留上下文与证据的共享记忆支持它们。做得好，这就是字面意义上的智能体编排：许多乐器，一份总谱，清晰的提示。

With that foundation in place, we now turn to ambient agents and the background services that watch event streams, detect conditions, and trigger workflows, to see how they complement multiagent designs on Kubernetes.

有了这个基础，我们现在转向环境智能体与监控事件流、检测条件、触发工作流的后台服务，看看它们如何在 Kubernetes 上补充多智能体设计。

Ambient Agents
环境智能体

Ambient agents run continuously in the background and react to signals from their environment rather than waiting for an interactive prompt. They live alongside your systems and take action when triggers fire: a new file appears, a row changes, a sensor crosses a threshold, or a timer goes off. Think of them as passive until needed; they do not start conversations, though they can (but do not need to) ask a human before they act.

环境智能体在后台持续运行，对环境信号做出反应，而非等待交互式提示。它们与你的系统并肩生存，在触发器触发时采取行动：新文件出现、行变化、传感器越过阈值、定时器响起。把它们想成在需要之前是被动的；它们不发起对话，尽管可以（但不必）在行动前询问人。

A practical example is a Kubernetes caretaker that monitors cluster health signals for crash loops or CPU pressure and immediately investigates by querying logs and comparing recent metrics. If the findings match a known pattern, the agent attempts a targeted remedy like restarting a deployment, rolling back a config, or scaling out a service, and escalates to a human only when automated actions fail or when policy marks the situation as high risk. The involved components of such an ambient agent setup are shown in Figure 8-13.

一个实际例子是 Kubernetes 管理员智能体——监控集群健康信号（crash loop 或 CPU 压力），立即通过查询日志与比较近期指标来调查。如果发现匹配已知模式，智能体尝试有针对性的补救——重启 deployment、回滚配置、或扩缩服务——只在自动化行动失败或策略标记情况为高风险时升级到人。这种环境智能体设置涉及的组件如图 8-13 所示。

原书第 336 页

Ambient agents are built on Event-Driven Architecture (EDA). They subscribe to queues, webhooks, file watchers, or scheduled triggers (like CronJobs); update their working context; decide whether to act; and then call tools. For example, a daily planning agent might run every morning at 2 a.m. to analyze yesterday's activity, generate a plan for the day, and send the result via email or post it to a notification channel for humans to review. For sensitive operations they insert human-in-the-loop (HITL) checkpoints: the agent drafts a plan, routes it to an approver, and executes only after an explicit "go." You can tune autonomy by policy—recommend only, approve to act, or auto for low risk—and you can bound variation with a determinism budget so replays and retries behave predictably. On the output side, every action should leave an evidence trail with inputs, decisions, and artifacts so operations remain auditable.

环境智能体构建在事件驱动架构（EDA）之上。它们订阅队列、webhook、文件监视器、或定时触发器（如 CronJob）；更新工作上下文；决定是否行动；然后调用工具。例如每日规划智能体可能每天凌晨 2 点运行，分析昨天的活动、生成当日计划、通过邮件发送结果或发到通知频道供人审查。对敏感操作它们插入人在环中（HITL）检查点：智能体起草计划，路由给审批者，只有在显式“go”后才执行。你可以按策略调优自治——仅推荐、批准后行动、或低风险自动——你可以用确定性预算约束变异，使重放与重试行为可预测。在输出侧，每个行动都应留下带输入、决策、制品的证据轨迹，使运营保持可审计。

Sidebar: Human in the Loop

Human in the loop is a deliberate checkpoint where a person reviews an agent's plan or outcome and explicitly authorizes the next step before the agent proceeds. You use it for high-risk or irreversible actions, when policy demands human oversight, or when signals are ambiguous and confidence is low. Typical examples include pushing a production hotfix, rolling back a config that could cause downtime, approving a large financial transaction, or sending a high-volume customer notification. Feedback can be gathered through chat and messaging systems like Slack or Teams, where the agent posts the proposed plan and waits for an approve or reject reply. A more decoupled pattern emits an approval request on a message bus with a correlation ID, then listens for the corresponding decision event, possibly emitted by an dedicated UI. For auditability, the agent should attach its rationale and diffs to the request, record the approver and decision, and post the final result after execution. This helps to keep autonomy where it is safe and moves judgment to humans where it matters most.

人在环中是一个有意的检查点：人审查智能体的计划或产出，并在智能体继续之前显式授权下一步。你在高风险或不可逆行动、策略要求人监督、或信号模糊且信心低时使用它。典型例子包括推送生产热修复、回滚可能导致停机的配置、批准大额金融交易、发送大批量客户通知。反馈可通过 Slack 或 Teams 等聊天与消息系统收集——智能体发布提议计划，等待批准或拒绝回复。更解耦的模式是在消息总线上发出带关联 ID 的审批请求，然后监听对应的决策事件（可能由专用 UI 发出）。为可审计，智能体应在请求中附上理由与 diff，记录审批者与决策，执行后发布最终结果。这有助于把自治保持在安全处，把判断移到最重要的人。

For ambient agents, the platform concerns are the same as for any distributed system: service discovery, retries and backoffs, circuit breakers, idempotent handlers, and clear ownership of configuration and secrets.

对环境智能体，平台关切与任何分布式系统相同：服务发现、重试与退避、断路器、幂等 handler、配置与 secret 的清晰所有权。

In practice, you will get the best results when ambient agents blend three disciplines: reliable event handling with idempotent actions, explicit human checkpoints for irreversible changes, and clear Kubernetes ownership boundaries for scaling and security. This keeps ambient agents predictable like any other microservice, while giving you the superpower of proactive operations at scale.

实践中，当环境智能体融合三项纪律时你会获得最佳结果：带幂等行动的可靠事件处理、对不可逆变更的显式人检查点、为扩缩与安全的清晰 Kubernetes 所有权边界。这让环境智能体像任何其他微服务一样可预测，同时给你大规模主动运营的超能力。

原书第 337 页

Lessons Learned
经验教训

In this chapter we explored how to architect complete AI-driven applications on Kubernetes, from chat interfaces to event-driven backends, RAG pipelines, and agentic workflows.

本章我们探索了如何在 Kubernetes 上架构完整的 AI 驱动应用——从对话接口到事件驱动后端、RAG 流水线、智能体工作流。

Application architectures fall into two dominant patterns with different operational characteristics. Interactive chat-style apps run synchronous request paths where latency matters most, requiring pre-warmed LLMs, lean orchestrators, and minimal round trips. Backend event-driven services run asynchronously within microservice meshes, where idempotency, buffering, and eventual consistency matter more than raw response time. Batch jobs, continuous control loops, and tool-driven automations sit alongside these cores, shifting nonurgent work off the hot path for cost efficiency.

应用架构分为两种主导模式，有不同运维特征。交互式对话风格应用运行同步请求路径，延迟最关键，需要预热 LLM、精简编排器、最少往返。后端事件驱动服务在微服务网格中异步运行，幂等、缓冲、最终一致比原始响应时间更重要。批作业、持续控制循环、工具驱动自动化与这些核心并肩，把非紧急工作移出热路径以提升成本效率。

RAG works best when ingestion and query-time pipelines maintain consistency and observability. Use one embedding model for both phases, choose chunking strategies that match your content, and store provenance for confident citation and filtering. Vector databases belong in StatefulSets with snapshot and restore plans, while ingestion runs as jobs or CronJobs that avoid starving user traffic. Rerankers can boost precision for high-stakes queries but should remain optional to trade cost for quality per route.

当摄取与查询时流水线保持一致与可观测时，RAG 效果最佳。两个阶段用同一嵌入模型，选择匹配你内容的分块策略，保存出处以做可靠引用与过滤。向量数据库属于带快照与恢复计划的 StatefulSet，而摄取作为 job 或 CronJob 运行，避免饿死用户流量。重排器可为高风险查询提升精度，但应保持可选，以便按路由用成本换质量。

Agentic workflows add explicit control loops around models and make tools first-class citizens. Human-in-the-loop approval gates for risky actions are essential, not afterthoughts. Capture rationale and artifacts, make every step auditable, and improve portability by using standards like MCP.

智能体工作流在模型周围加显式控制循环，让工具成为一等公民。对风险行动的人在环中审批门是必需的，不是事后补充。捕获理由与制品，让每步可审计，用 MCP 等标准提升可移植性。

With these patterns and boundaries in hand, we are ready to go deeper into the how. In the next chapter we turn these high-level designs into production guidance and show how to stand up agentic applications on Kubernetes, as well as dive into trickier challenges like securing MCP and A2A communications.

有了这些模式与边界，我们准备好深入 how。下一章我们把这些高层设计转为生产指南，展示如何在 Kubernetes 上建立智能体应用，并深入更棘手的挑战——如保护 MCP 与 A2A 通信。
